Events.FloodEvent = {
    title: _('洪水'),
    isAvailable: function() {
        if(Engine.activeModule !== Room && Engine.activeModule !== Outside) return false;
        var huts = $SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]', true);
        if(huts < 4) return false;
        var lastFlood = $SM.get('game.lastFloodEvent', true);
        if(lastFlood && (Date.now() - lastFlood < 300000)) return false;

        return true;
    },
    scenes: {
        start: {
            text: [
                _('连日的大雨让河水暴涨，堤岸终于不堪重负。'),
                _('浑浊的洪水如脱缰的野马般冲垮了河堤，涌入村庄。'),
                _('水位正在急速上升！')
            ],

            buttons: {
                'supplies': {
                    text: _('抢救物资'),
                    onChoose: function() {
                        $SM.set('game.lastFloodEvent', Date.now());
                        var huts = $SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]', true);
                        var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true);
                        var lostHuts = Math.min(huts, 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3));
                        var killPop = Math.min(pop, 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2));

                        $SM.add('game.buildings["hut"]', -lostHuts);
                        $SM.add('game.population', -killPop);
                        if($SM.get('game.population') < 0) $SM.set('game.population', 0);
                        if($SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]') < 0) $SM.set('game.buildings["hut"]', 0);

                        var woodLoss = Math.floor($SM.get('stores.wood', true) * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3));
                        var clothLoss = Math.floor($SM.get('stores.cloth', true) * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3));
                        var storeMod = {};
                        if(woodLoss > 0) storeMod.wood = -woodLoss;
                        if(clothLoss > 0) storeMod.cloth = -clothLoss;
                        if(Object.keys(storeMod).length > 0) $SM.addM('stores', storeMod);

                        var remaining = Outside.getNumGatherers();
                        if(remaining < 0) {
                            var gap = -remaining;
                            var workers = $SM.get('game.workers') || {};
                            for(var k in workers) {
                                var num = workers[k];
                                if(num < gap) { gap -= num; $SM.set('game.workers["'+k+'"]', 0); }
                                else { $SM.add('game.workers["'+k+'"]', gap * -1); break; }
                            }
                        }
                        Outside.updateVillage();
                        Outside.updateWorkersView();
                        Room.updateStoresView();
                        Room.updateIncomeView();
                        Room.updateBuildButtons();

                        var resultText = [
                            _('你争分夺秒地将物资搬到高处，大部分食物和毛皮被保住了。'),
                            _('洪水退去后，满地泥泞和残骸。')
                        ];

                        Events.FloodEvent.scenes.aftermath.text = resultText;
                        Events.loadScene('aftermath');
                    }
                },
                'levee': {
                    text: _('加固堤坝'),
                    cost: {'wood': 300, 'cloth': 200},
                    onChoose: function() {
                        $SM.set('game.lastFloodEvent', Date.now());

                        var medicineNeeded = 3;
                        var medicineHave = $SM.get('stores.medicine', true);
                        if(medicineHave >= medicineNeeded) {
                            $SM.add('stores.medicine', -medicineNeeded);
                            var resultText = [
                                _('你率众用沙袋和木桩加固堤防，守住了村庄。'),
                                _('洪水退去后的疫情也被药品控制住了，村庄虽然狼狈，但挺了过来。')
                            ];
                        } else {
                            var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true);
                            var killPop = Math.min(pop, 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5));
                            $SM.add('game.population', -killPop);
                            if($SM.get('game.population') < 0) $SM.set('game.population', 0);
                            if(medicineHave > 0) $SM.set('stores.medicine', 0);

                            var remaining = Outside.getNumGatherers();
                            if(remaining < 0) {
                                var gap = -remaining;
                                var workers = $SM.get('game.workers') || {};
                                for(var k in workers) {
                                    var num = workers[k];
                                    if(num < gap) { gap -= num; $SM.set('game.workers["'+k+'"]', 0); }
                                    else { $SM.add('game.workers["'+k+'"]', gap * -1); break; }
                                }
                            }
                            Outside.updateVillage();
                            Outside.updateWorkersView();
                            Room.updateStoresView();
                            Room.updateIncomeView();
                            Room.updateBuildButtons();

                            var resultText = [
                                _('你率众用沙袋和木桩加固堤防，守住了村庄，但洪水退去后瘟疫开始流行。'),
                                _('药品不够，不少村民没能撑过这一劫。')
                            ];
                        }

                        Outside.updateVillage();
                        Outside.updateWorkersView();
                        Room.updateStoresView();
                        Room.updateIncomeView();
                        Room.updateBuildButtons();

                        Events.FloodEvent.scenes.aftermath.text = resultText;
                        Events.loadScene('aftermath');
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        aftermath: {
            text: [],
            buttons: {
                'continue': {
                    text: _('继续'),
                    nextScene: 'end'
                }
            }
        }
    }

                        if($SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]') < 0) $SM.set('game.buildings["hut"]', 0);

                        if($SM.get('game.buildings["smokehouse"]', true) > 0) {
                            $SM.add('game.buildings["smokehouse"]', -1);
                        }

                        $SM.add('stores.meat', 200);

                        var remaining = Outside.getNumGatherers();
                        if(remaining < 0) {
                            var gap = -remaining;
                            var workers = $SM.get('game.workers') || {};
                            for(var k in workers) {
                                var num = workers[k];
                                if(num < gap) { gap -= num; $SM.set('game.workers["'+k+'"]', 0); }
                                else { $SM.add('game.workers["'+k+'"]', gap * -1); break; }
                            }
                        }
                        Outside.updateVillage();
                        Outside.updateWorkersView();
                        Room.updateStoresView();
                        Room.updateIncomeView();
                        Room.updateBuildButtons();

                        var resultText = [
                            _('你带领村民拼命向高处奔跑，海啸摧毁了沿海的建筑，但大部分人都活了下来。'),
                            _('海浪退去后，被冲上岸的鱼群成了意外的收获。')
                        ];

                        Events.TsunamiEvent.scenes.aftermath.text = resultText;
                        Events.loadScene('aftermath');
                    }
                },
                'secure': {
                    text: _('固定设施'),
                    onChoose: function() {
                        $SM.set('game.lastTsunamiEvent', Date.now());
                        var huts = $SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]', true);
                        var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true);
                        var lostHuts = Math.min(huts, Math.floor(huts * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.3)));
                        var killPop = Math.min(pop, 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4));

                        $SM.add('game.buildings["hut"]', -lostHuts);
                        $SM.add('game.population', -killPop);
                        if($SM.get('game.population') < 0) $SM.set('game.population', 0);
                        if($SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]') < 0) $SM.set('game.buildings["hut"]', 0);

                        if($SM.get('game.buildings["smokehouse"]', true) > 0) $SM.add('game.buildings["smokehouse"]', -1);
                        if($SM.get('game.buildings["tannery"]', true) > 0) $SM.add('game.buildings["tannery"]', -1);

                        var clothLoss = Math.floor($SM.get('stores.cloth', true) * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.3));
                        var woodLoss = Math.floor($SM.get('stores.wood', true) * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3));
                        var storeMod = {};
                        if(clothLoss > 0) storeMod.cloth = -clothLoss;
                        if(woodLoss > 0) storeMod.wood = -woodLoss;
                        if(Object.keys(storeMod).length > 0) $SM.addM('stores', storeMod);

                        var remaining = Outside.getNumGatherers();
                        if(remaining < 0) {
                            var gap = -remaining;
                            var workers = $SM.get('game.workers') || {};
                            for(var k in workers) {
                                var num = workers[k];
                                if(num < gap) { gap -= num; $SM.set('game.workers["'+k+'"]', 0); }
                                else { $SM.add('game.workers["'+k+'"]', gap * -1); break; }
                            }
                        }
                        Outside.updateVillage();
                        Outside.updateWorkersView();
                        Room.updateStoresView();
                        Room.updateIncomeView();
                        Room.updateBuildButtons();

                        var resultText = [
                            _('你试图固定所有设施，但在自然之力面前毫无用处，几乎所有沿海建筑都被摧毁了。'),
                            _('海面恢复了平静，但留下的只有满目疮痍。')
                        ];

                        Events.TsunamiEvent.scenes.aftermath.text = resultText;
                        Events.loadScene('aftermath');
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        aftermath: {
            text: [],
            buttons: {
                'continue': {
                    text: _('继续'),
                    nextScene: 'end'
                }
            }
        }
    }

window.DisasterWeightManager = {
    name: 'DisasterWeightManager',

    enabled: true,

    cfg: {
        chance: 1.0,
        weights: {
            earthquake: 15,
            volcano:    10,
            flood:      15,
            drought:    15,
            tornado:    12,
            blizzard:   15,
            sandstorm:  12,
            tsunami:    10
        }
    },

    _DEFAULTS: null,

    _events: {},

    _loaded: false,

    init: function() {
        if (!this._DEFAULTS) {
            this._DEFAULTS = $.extend(true, {}, this.cfg);
        }
    },

    ensureConfig: function() {
        this.init();
        if (this._loaded) return;
        this._loaded = true;
        try {
            var saved = $SM.get('game.disasterCfg', true);
            if (saved && typeof saved === 'object') {


                if (typeof saved.chance === 'number' && saved.chance >= 0.5 && saved.chance <= 10) {
                    this.cfg.chance = saved.chance;
                }
                if (saved.weights && typeof saved.weights === 'object') {
                    for (var k in this.cfg.weights) {
                        var w = saved.weights[k];
                        if (typeof w === 'number' && w >= 0) this.cfg.weights[k] = w;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {  }
    },

    saveConfig: function() {
        try {
            this.init();
            $SM.set('game.disasterCfg', $.extend(true, {}, this.cfg));
        } catch (e) {  }
    },


    setChance: function(c) {
        this.ensureConfig();
        if (typeof c !== 'number' || c < 0.5 || c > 10) return false;
        this.cfg.chance = c;
        this.saveConfig();
        return true;
    },

    setWeight: function(key, w) {
        this.ensureConfig();
        if (!(key in this.cfg.weights)) return false;
        if (typeof w !== 'number' || w < 0) return false;
        this.cfg.weights[key] = w;
        this.saveConfig();
        return true;
    },

    reset: function() {
        this.init();
        this.cfg = $.extend(true, {}, this._DEFAULTS);
        this.saveConfig();
    },

    getChance: function() {
        this.ensureConfig();
        return this.cfg.chance;
    },

    getWeights: function() {
        this.ensureConfig();
        return $.extend(true, {}, this.cfg.weights);
    },

    getInfo: function() {
        this.ensureConfig();
        return {
            enabled: this.enabled,
            chance: this.cfg.chance,
            weights: this.getWeights(),
            stats: this.getStats()
        };
    },

    getStats: function() {
        try {
            return $SM.get('game.disasterStats', true) || {};
        } catch (e) { return {}; }
    },

    _record: function(key) {
        try {
            var stats = this.getStats();
            stats[key] = (stats[key] || 0) + 1;
            $SM.set('game.disasterStats', stats);
        } catch (e) {  }
    },

    weightedPick: function(entries) {
        if (!entries || !entries.length) return null;
        var total = 0, i;
        for (i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
            var w = entries[i][1];
            total += (typeof w === 'number' && w > 0) ? w : 0;
        }
        if (total <= 0) return entries[Math.floor(Math.random() * entries.length)][0];
        var r = Math.random() * total;
        for (i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
            var w2 = entries[i][1];
            r -= (typeof w2 === 'number' && w2 > 0) ? w2 : 0;
            if (r < 0) return entries[i][0];
        }
        return entries[entries.length - 1][0];
    },

    registerAll: function() {
        this._events = {
            earthquake: Events.EarthquakeEvent,
            volcano:    Events.VolcanoEvent,
            flood:      Events.FloodEvent,
            drought:    Events.DroughtEvent,
            tornado:    Events.TornadoEvent,
            blizzard:   Events.BlizzardEvent,
            sandstorm:  Events.SandstormEvent,
            tsunami:    Events.TsunamiEvent
        };
    },

    _keyOf: function(event) {
        for (var k in this._events) {
            if (this._events[k] === event) return k;
        }
        return null;
    },









    choose: function(possibleEvents) {
        if (!this.enabled) return { handled: false };
        this.ensureConfig();
        this.registerAllIfNeeded();
        if (!possibleEvents || possibleEvents.length === 0) {
            return { handled: false };
        }

        var disasters = [], others = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < possibleEvents.length; i++) {
            var ev = possibleEvents[i];
            if (this._keyOf(ev)) disasters.push(ev);
            else others.push(ev);
        }

        if (disasters.length === 0) return { handled: false };


        var pool = others.slice();
        for (var d = 0; d < disasters.length; d++) {
            var key = this._keyOf(disasters[d]);
            var w = (key !== null && typeof this.cfg.weights[key] === 'number') ? this.cfg.weights[key] : 0;
            var p = (w / 1000) * this.cfg.chance;
            if (p > 0 && Math.random() < Math.min(p, 1)) {
                pool.push(disasters[d]);
            }
        }

        if (pool.length === 0) {
            return { handled: true, event: null };
        }
        var picked = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
        var pickedKey = this._keyOf(picked);



        if (pickedKey) {
            this._record(pickedKey);
            this._stampCooldown(pickedKey);
            Engine.log('DisasterWeightManager: disaster triggered → ' + pickedKey);
        }
        return { handled: true, event: picked };
    },

    _COOLDOWN: {
        earthquake: 'game.lastEarthquakeEvent',
        volcano:    'game.lastVolcanoEvent',
        flood:      'game.lastFloodEvent',
        drought:    'game.lastDroughtEvent',
        tornado:    'game.lastTornadoEvent',
        blizzard:   'game.lastBlizzardEvent',
        sandstorm:  'game.lastSandstormEvent',
        tsunami:    'game.lastTsunamiEvent'
    },

    _stampCooldown: function(key) {
        try {
            var path = this._COOLDOWN[key];
            if (path) $SM.set(path, Date.now());
        } catch (e) {  }
    },

    registerAllIfNeeded: function() {

        for (var k in this._events) { return; }
        this.registerAll();
    },

    forceTrigger: function(key) {
        this.registerAllIfNeeded();
        var ev = this._events[key];
        if (!ev) return '未知天灾 key: ' + key + ' (可选: earthquake/volcano/flood/drought/tornado/blizzard/sandstorm/tsunami)';
        if (Events.activeEvent()) return '当前已有事件面板, 稍后再试';
        this._stampCooldown(key);
        Events.startEvent(ev);
        return '已强制触发: ' + key;
    }
};
DisasterWeightManager.init();


                Events.eventStack = [];

                Events.scheduleNextEvent();

                $.Dispatch('stateUpdate').subscribe(Events.handleStateUpdates);
        },

        options: {},

        activeEvent: null,
        activeScene: null,
        eventPanel: null,

        loadScene: function(name) {
                Engine.log('loading scene: ' + name);
                Events.activeScene = name;
                var scene = Events.activeEvent().scenes[name];

                if(scene.reward) {
                        $SM.addM('stores', scene.reward);
                }

                if(scene.onLoad) {
                        scene.onLoad();
                }

                if(scene.notification) {
                        Notifications.notify(null, scene.notification);
                }

                $('#description', Events.eventPanel()).empty();
                $('#buttons', Events.eventPanel()).empty();
                if(scene.combat) {
                        Events.startCombat(scene);
                } else {
                        Events.startStory(scene);
                }
        },

        startCombat: function(scene) {
                Engine.event('game event', 'combat');
                Events.won = false;

                Events.clearPoison();
                $('#wanderer').removeData('stunned');
                $('#enemy').removeData('stunned');
                var desc = $('#description', Events.eventPanel());

                $('<div>').text(scene.notification).appendTo(desc);

                Events.createFighterDiv('@', World.health, World.getMaxHealth()).attr('id', 'wanderer').appendTo(desc);

                Events.createFighterDiv(scene.chara, scene.health, scene.health).attr('id', 'enemy').appendTo(desc);

                var btns = $('#buttons', Events.eventPanel());
                        btns.addClass('combat-buttons-wrap');

                Events.createAttackButton('fists').prependTo(btns);

                var carriedWeapons = [];
                for(var k in World.Weapons) {
                        if(k == 'fists') continue;
                        var weapon = World.Weapons[k];
                        if(typeof Path.outfit[k] == 'number' && Path.outfit[k] > 0) {
                                var usable = true;
                                if(weapon.cost) {
                                        for(var c in weapon.cost) {
                                                var num = weapon.cost[c];
                                                if(typeof Path.outfit[c] != 'number' || Path.outfit[c] < num) {

                                                        usable = false;
                                                        break;
                                                }
                                        }
                                }
                                if(usable) {
                                        carriedWeapons.push(k);
                                }
                        }
                }

                carriedWeapons.sort(function(a, b) {
                        var dmgA = typeof World.Weapons[a].damage == 'number' ? World.Weapons[a].damage : 0;
                        var dmgB = typeof World.Weapons[b].damage == 'number' ? World.Weapons[b].damage : 0;
                        return dmgB - dmgA;
                });

                for(var i = 0; i < carriedWeapons.length && i < 3; i++) {
                        Events.createAttackButton(carriedWeapons[i]).appendTo(btns);
                }

                Events.createEatMeatButton().appendTo(btns);
                if((Path.outfit['medicine'] || 0) != 0) {
                  Events.createUseMedsButton().appendTo(btns);
          }
                if((Path.outfit['disinfectant'] || 0) != 0) {
                  Events.createUseDisinfectantButton().appendTo(btns);
          }

                Events._enemyAttackTimer = setTimeout(Events.enemyAttack, scene.attackDelay * 1000);
        },

        createEatMeatButton: function(cooldown) {
                if (cooldown == null) {
                        cooldown = Events._EAT_COOLDOWN;
                }

                var btn = new Button.Button({
                        id: 'eat',
                        text: _('eat meat'),
                        cooldown: cooldown,
                        click: Events.eatMeat,
                        cost: { 'cured meat': 1 }
                });

                if(Path.outfit['cured meat'] == 0) {
                        Button.setDisabled(btn, true);
                }

                return btn;
        },

        createUseMedsButton: function(cooldown) {
                if (cooldown == null) {
                        cooldown = Events._MEDS_COOLDOWN;
                }

                var btn = new Button.Button({
                        id: 'meds',
                        text: _('use meds'),
                        cooldown: cooldown,
                        click: Events.useMeds,
                        cost: { 'medicine': 1 }
                });

                if((Path.outfit['medicine'] || 0) == 0) {
                        Button.setDisabled(btn, true);
                }

                return btn;
        },

        createUseDisinfectantButton: function(cooldown) {
                if (cooldown == null) {
                        cooldown = 3;
                }

                var btn = new Button.Button({
                        id: 'disinfectant',
                        text: _('use disinfectant'),
                        cooldown: cooldown,
                        click: Events.useDisinfectant,
                        cost: { 'disinfectant': 1 }
                });

                if((Path.outfit['disinfectant'] || 0) == 0) {
                        Button.setDisabled(btn, true);
                }

                return btn;
        },

        createAttackButton: function(weaponName) {
                var weapon = World.Weapons[weaponName];
                var cd = weapon.cooldown;
                if(weapon.type == 'unarmed') {
                        if($SM.hasPerk('unarmed master')) {
                                cd /= 2;
                        }
                }
                var btn = new Button.Button({
                        id: 'attack_' + weaponName.replace(' ', '-'),
                        text: weapon.verb,
                        cooldown: cd,
                        click: Events.useWeapon,
                        cost: weapon.cost
                });
                if(typeof weapon.damage == 'number' && weapon.damage > 0) {
                        btn.addClass('weaponButton');
                }

                for(var k in weapon.cost) {
                        if(typeof Path.outfit[k] != 'number' || Path.outfit[k] < weapon.cost[k]) {
                                Button.setDisabled(btn, true);
                                break;
                        }
                }

                return btn;
        },

        drawFloatText: function(text, parent) {
                $('<div>').text(text).addClass('damageText').appendTo(parent).animate({
                        'bottom': '50px',
                        'opacity': '0'
                },
                300,
                'linear',
                function() {
                        $(this).remove();
                });
        },

        eatMeat: function() {
                if(Path.outfit['cured meat'] > 0) {
                        Path.outfit['cured meat']--;
                        World.updateSupplies();
                        if(Path.outfit['cured meat'] == 0) {
                                Button.setDisabled($('#eat'), true);
                        }

                        var hp = World.health;
                        hp += World.meatHeal();
                        hp = hp > World.getMaxHealth() ? World.getMaxHealth() : hp;
                        World.setHp(hp);

                        if(Events.activeEvent()) {
                                var w = $('#wanderer');
                                w.data('hp', hp);
                                Events.updateFighterDiv(w);
                                Events.drawFloatText('+' + World.meatHeal(), '#wanderer .hp');
                        }
                }
        },

        useMeds: function() {
                if(Path.outfit['medicine'] > 0) {
                        Path.outfit['medicine']--;
                        World.updateSupplies();
                        if(Path.outfit['medicine'] == 0) {
                                Button.setDisabled($('#meds'), true);
                        }

                        var hp = World.health;
                        hp += World.medsHeal();
                        hp = hp > World.getMaxHealth() ? World.getMaxHealth() : hp;
                        World.setHp(hp);

                        if(Events.activeEvent()) {
                                var w = $('#wanderer');
                                w.data('hp', hp);
                                Events.updateFighterDiv(w);
                                Events.drawFloatText('+' + World.medsHeal(), '#wanderer .hp');
                        }
                }
        },

        useDisinfectant: function() {
                if((Path.outfit['disinfectant'] || 0) > 0) {
                        Path.outfit['disinfectant']--;
                        World.updateSupplies();
                        if((Path.outfit['disinfectant'] || 0) == 0) {
                                Button.setDisabled($('#disinfectant'), true);
                        }

                        var heal = 5;
                        var hp = World.health + heal;
                        hp = hp > World.getMaxHealth() ? World.getMaxHealth() : hp;
                        World.setHp(hp);

                        if(Events.activeEvent()) {
                                var w = $('#wanderer');
                                w.data('hp', hp);
                                Events.updateFighterDiv(w);
                                Events.drawFloatText('+' + heal, '#wanderer .hp');
                        }
                }
        },

        useWeapon: function(btn) {
                if(Events.activeEvent()) {

                        if($('#wanderer').data('stunned')) {
                                Events.drawFloatText('眩晕中', $('.hp', '#wanderer'));
                                return;
                        }
                        var weaponName = btn.attr('id').substring(7).replace('-', ' ');
                        var weapon = World.Weapons[weaponName];
                        if(weapon.type == 'unarmed') {
                                if(!$SM.get('character.punches')) $SM.set('character.punches', 0);
                                $SM.add('character.punches', 1);
                                if($SM.get('character.punches') == 50 && !$SM.hasPerk('boxer')) {
                                        $SM.addPerk('boxer');
                                } else if($SM.get('character.punches') == 150 && !$SM.hasPerk('martial artist')) {
                                        $SM.addPerk('martial artist');
                                } else if($SM.get('character.punches') == 300 && !$SM.hasPerk('unarmed master')) {
                                        $SM.addPerk('unarmed master');
                                }

                        }
                        if(weapon.cost) {
                                var mod = {};
                                var out = false;
                                for(var k in weapon.cost) {
                                        if(typeof Path.outfit[k] != 'number' || Path.outfit[k] < weapon.cost[k]) {
                                                return;
                                        }
                                        mod[k] = -weapon.cost[k];
                                        if(Path.outfit[k] - weapon.cost[k] < weapon.cost[k]) {
                                                out = true;
                                        }
                                }
                                for(var k in mod) {
                                        Path.outfit[k] += mod[k];
                                }
                                if(out) {
                                        Button.setDisabled(btn, true);
                                        var validWeapons = false;
                                        $('.weaponButton').each(function(){
                                                if(!Button.isDisabled($(this)) && $(this).attr('id') != 'attack_fists') {
                                                        validWeapons = true;
                                                        return false;
                                                }
                                        });
                                        if(!validWeapons) {

                                                var fists = $('#attack_fists');
                                                if(fists.length == 0) {
                                                        Events.createAttackButton('fists').prependTo('#buttons', Events.eventPanel());
                                                } else {
                                                        Button.setDisabled(fists, false);
                                                }
                                        }
                                }
                                World.updateSupplies();
                        }
                        var dmg = -1;
                        var hitChance = World.getHitChance();

                        if(weapon.hitBonus) {
                                hitChance = Math.min(1, hitChance + weapon.hitBonus);
                        }
                        if(Math.random() <= hitChance) {
                                dmg = weapon.damage;
                                if(typeof dmg == 'number') {
                                        if(weapon.type == 'unarmed' && $SM.hasPerk('boxer')) {
                                                dmg *= 2;
                                        }
                                        if(weapon.type == 'unarmed' && $SM.hasPerk('martial artist')) {
                                                dmg *= 3;
                                        }
                                        if(weapon.type == 'unarmed' && $SM.hasPerk('unarmed master')) {
                                                dmg *= 2;
                                        }
                                        if(weapon.type == 'melee' && $SM.hasPerk('barbarian')) {
                                                dmg = Math.floor(dmg * 1.5);
                                        }
                                }
                        }



                        var stunMs = 0;
                        if(typeof dmg == 'number' && dmg > 0) {
                                if(weapon.stun && Math.random() <= weapon.stun.chance) {
                                        stunMs = weapon.stun.duration;
                                }
                                if(weapon.poison && Math.random() <= weapon.poison.chance) {
                                        Events.applyPoison(weapon.poison);
                                }
                        }

                        var attackFn = weapon.type == 'ranged' ? Events.animateRanged : Events.animateMelee;
                        attackFn($('#wanderer'), dmg, function() {

                                if (weapon.selfDamageReflect && typeof dmg == 'number' && dmg > 0) {
                                        if (Math.random() <= weapon.selfDamageReflect.chance) {
                                                var reflectDmg = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dmg * weapon.selfDamageReflect.ratio));
                                                var newHp = World.health - reflectDmg;
                                                World.setHp(newHp);
                                                if (Events.activeEvent()) {
                                                        var w = $('#wanderer');
                                                        w.data('hp', newHp);
                                                        Events.updateFighterDiv(w);
                                                        Events.drawFloatText('-' + reflectDmg, '#wanderer .hp');
                                                        Notifications.notify(null, _('the explosive blew back at you'));
                                                }

                                                if (newHp <= 0 && typeof World !== 'undefined' && World.die) {

                                                        if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined') Engine.keyLock = true;
                                                        if ($('#enemyAttackTimer')) { try { clearTimeout(Events._enemyAttackTimer); } catch(_e){} }
                                                        World.die();
                                                        return;
                                                }
                                        }
                                }

                                if($('#enemy').data('hp') <= 0 && !Events.won) {

                                        Events.winFight();
                                }
                        }, stunMs);
                }
        },

        onPlayerHit: function(dmg, stunMs) {
                if(typeof dmg != 'number' || dmg <= 0) return;

                if(stunMs && stunMs > 0) {
                        $('#wanderer').data('stunned', true);
                        Events.drawFloatText('已昏迷', $('.hp', '#wanderer'));
                        setTimeout(function() {
                                $('#wanderer').data('stunned', false);
                        }, stunMs);
                }

        },

        animateMelee: function(fighter, dmg, callback, stunMs) {
                var start, end, enemy;
                if(fighter.attr('id') == 'wanderer') {
                        start = {'left': '50%'};
                        end = {'left': '25%'};
                        enemy = $('#enemy');
                } else {
                        start = {'right': '50%'};
                        end = {'right': '25%'};
                        enemy = $('#wanderer');
                }

                fighter.stop(true, true).animate(start, Events._FIGHT_SPEED, function() {
                        var enemyHp = enemy.data('hp');
                        var msg = "";
                        if(typeof dmg == 'number') {
                                if(dmg < 0) {
                                        msg = '失手';
                                        dmg = 0;
                                } else {
                                        msg = '-' + dmg;
                                        enemyHp -= dmg;
                                        enemy.data('hp', enemyHp);
                                        if(fighter.attr('id') == 'enemy') {
                                                World.setHp(enemyHp);

                                                Events.onPlayerHit(dmg, stunMs);
                                        } else if(stunMs && stunMs > 0) {

                                                enemy.data('stunned', true);
                                                msg += ' 已昏迷';
                                                setTimeout(function() {
                                                        enemy.data('stunned', false);
                                                }, stunMs);
                                        }
                                        Events.updateFighterDiv(enemy);
                                }
                        } else {
                                if(dmg == 'stun') {
                                        msg = '已昏迷';
                                        enemy.data('stunned', true);
                                        setTimeout(function() {
                                                enemy.data('stunned', false);
                                        }, Events.STUN_DURATION);
                                }
                        }

                        Events.drawFloatText(msg, $('.hp', enemy));

                        $(this).animate(end, Events._FIGHT_SPEED, callback);
                });
        },

        animateRanged: function(fighter, dmg, callback, stunMs) {
                var start, end, enemy;
                if(fighter.attr('id') == 'wanderer') {
                        start = {'left': '25%'};
                        end = {'left': '50%'};
                        enemy = $('#enemy');
                } else {
                        start = {'right': '25%'};
                        end = {'right': '50%'};
                        enemy = $('#wanderer');
                }

                $('<div>').css(start).addClass('bullet').text('o').appendTo('#description')
                                .animate(end, Events._FIGHT_SPEED * 2, 'linear', function() {
                        var enemyHp = enemy.data('hp');
                        var msg = "";
                        if(typeof dmg == 'number') {
                                if(dmg < 0) {
                                        msg = '失手';
                                        dmg = 0;
                                } else {
                                        msg = '-' + dmg;
                                        enemyHp -= dmg;
                                        enemy.data('hp', enemyHp);
                                        if(fighter.attr('id') == 'enemy') {
                                                World.setHp(enemyHp);

                                                Events.onPlayerHit(dmg, stunMs);
                                        } else if(stunMs && stunMs > 0) {

                                                enemy.data('stunned', true);
                                                msg += ' 已昏迷';
                                                setTimeout(function() {
                                                        enemy.data('stunned', false);
                                                }, stunMs);
                                        }
                                        Events.updateFighterDiv(enemy);
                                }
                        } else {
                                if(dmg == 'stun') {
                                        msg = '已昏迷';
                                        enemy.data('stunned', true);
                                        setTimeout(function() {
                                                enemy.data('stunned', false);
                                        }, Events.STUN_DURATION);
                                }
                        }

                        Events.drawFloatText(msg, $('.hp', enemy));

                        $(this).remove();
                        if(typeof callback == 'function') {
                                callback();
                        }
                });
        },



        applyPoison: function(p) {
                var now = Date.now();
                if(Events._poisonState) {

                        Events._poisonState.endsAt = now + p.duration;
                        return;
                }
                Events._poisonState = { dps: p.dps, interval: p.interval, endsAt: now + p.duration };
                Events._poisonTimer = setInterval(function() {
                        try {
                                var st = Events._poisonState;
                                if(!st || !Events.activeEvent() || Events.won || !$('#enemy').length) {
                                        Events.clearPoison();
                                        return;
                                }
                                if(Date.now() > st.endsAt) {
                                        Events.clearPoison();
                                        return;
                                }
                                var en = $('#enemy');
                                var eHp = en.data('hp');
                                if(typeof eHp != 'number') {
                                        Events.clearPoison();
                                        return;
                                }
                                eHp -= st.dps;
                                en.data('hp', eHp);
                                Events.updateFighterDiv(en);
                                Events.drawFloatText('中毒 -' + st.dps, $('.hp', en));
                                if(eHp <= 0 && !Events.won) {
                                        Events.winFight();
                                }
                        } catch(e) {
                                Events.clearPoison();
                        }
                }, p.interval);
        },

        clearPoison: function() {
                if(Events._poisonTimer) {
                        clearInterval(Events._poisonTimer);
                        Events._poisonTimer = null;
                }
                Events._poisonState = null;
        },

        enemyAttack: function() {

                var scene = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene];

                if(!$('#enemy').data('stunned')) {
                        var toHit = scene.hit;
                        toHit *= $SM.hasPerk('evasive') ? 0.8 : 1;
                        var dmg = -1;
                        if(Math.random() <= toHit) {
                                dmg = scene.damage;
                        }

                        var stunMs = 0;
                        if(typeof dmg == 'number' && dmg > 0 && scene.stun && Math.random() <= scene.stun.chance) {
                                stunMs = scene.stun.duration;
                        }

                        var attackFn = scene.ranged ? Events.animateRanged : Events.animateMelee;

                        attackFn($('#enemy'), dmg, function() {
                                        if($('#wanderer').data('hp') <= 0) {

                                                clearTimeout(Events._enemyAttackTimer);
                                                Events.endEvent();
                                                World.die();
                                        }
                        }, stunMs);
                }

                Events._enemyAttackTimer =
                        setTimeout(Events.enemyAttack, scene.attackDelay * 1000);
        },

        winFight: function() {
                Events.won = true;

                if (typeof Achievements !== 'undefined') {
                        try {
                                var _scene = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene];
                                if (_scene && _scene.enemy === 'tentacles') {
                                        Achievements.unlock('tentacle_defeated');
                                }
                        } catch(e) {}
                }

                if (typeof Achievements !== 'undefined') {
                        try {
                                var _scene = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene];
                                if (_scene && _scene.loot) {
                                        for (var lootKey in _scene.loot) {
                                                if (lootKey === 'bulletproof vest' && !$SM.get('stores["bulletproof vest"]', true)) {

                                                }

                                        }
                                }
                        } catch(e) {}
                }
                clearTimeout(Events._enemyAttackTimer);

                Events.clearPoison();
                $('#enemy').animate({opacity: 0}, 300, 'linear', function() {
                        setTimeout(function() {
                                try {
                                        var scene = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene];
                                        var desc = $('#description', Events.eventPanel());
                                        var btns = $('#buttons', Events.eventPanel());
                                        desc.empty();
                                        btns.empty();
                                        $('<div>').text(scene.deathMessage).appendTo(desc);


                                        var lootToDraw = scene.loot;
                                        if (typeof World !== 'undefined' && World.isBeastEnemy(scene.enemy)) {
                                                lootToDraw = $.extend({}, scene.loot || {});
                                                World.addBeastDrops(lootToDraw);
                                        }
                                        Events.drawLoot(lootToDraw);

                                        if(scene.buttons) {

                                                Events.drawButtons(scene);
                                        } else {
                                                new Button.Button({
                                                        id: 'leaveBtn',
                                                        click: function() {
                                                                var scene = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene];
                                                                if(scene.nextScene && scene.nextScene != 'end') {
                                                                        Events.loadScene(scene.nextScene);
                                                                } else {
                                                                        Events.endEvent();
                                                                }
                                                        },
                                                        text: _('leave')
                                                }).appendTo(btns);

                                                Events.createEatMeatButton(0).appendTo(btns);
                                                if((Path.outfit['medicine'] || 0) != 0) {
                                                  Events.createUseMedsButton(0).appendTo(btns);
                                          }
                                        }
                                } catch(e) {

                                }
                        }, 1000);
                });
        },

        drawLoot: function(lootList) {
                var desc = $('#description', Events.eventPanel());
                var lootButtons = $('<div>').attr('id', 'lootButtons');
                for(var k in lootList) {
                        var loot = lootList[k];
                        if(Math.random() < loot.chance) {
                                var num = Math.floor(Math.random() * (loot.max - loot.min)) + loot.min;
                                new Button.Button({
                                        id: 'loot_' + k.replace(' ', '-'),
                                        text: _(k) + ' [' + num + ']',
                                        click: Events.getLoot
                                }).data('numLeft', num).appendTo(lootButtons);
                        }
                }
                $('<div>').addClass('clear').appendTo(lootButtons);
                if(lootButtons.children().length > 1) {
                        lootButtons.appendTo(desc);
                }
        },

        dropStuff: function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                var btn = $(this);
                var thing = btn.data('thing');
                var num = btn.data('num');
                var lootButtons = $('#lootButtons');
                Engine.log('dropping ' + num + ' ' + thing);

                var lootBtn = $('#loot_' + thing.replace(' ', '-'), lootButtons);
                if(lootBtn.length > 0) {
                        var curNum = lootBtn.data('numLeft');
                        curNum += num;
                        lootBtn.text(_(thing) + ' [' + curNum + ']').data('numLeft', curNum);
                } else {
                        new Button.Button({
                                id: 'loot_' + thing.replace(' ', '-'),
                                text: _(thing) + ' [' + num + ']',
                                click: Events.getLoot
                        }).data('numLeft', num).insertBefore($('.clear', lootButtons));
                }
                Path.outfit[thing] -= num;
                Events.getLoot(btn.closest('.button'));
                World.updateSupplies();
        },

        getLoot: function(btn) {
                var name = btn.attr('id').substring(5).replace('-', ' ');
                if(btn.data('numLeft') > 0) {
                        var weight = Path.getWeight(name);
                        var freeSpace = Path.getFreeSpace();
                        if(weight <= freeSpace) {
                                var num = btn.data('numLeft');
                                num--;
                                btn.data('numLeft', num);
                                if(num == 0) {
                                        Button.setDisabled(btn);
                                        btn.animate({'opacity':0}, 300, 'linear', function() {
                                                $(this).remove();
                                                if($('#lootButtons').children().length == 1) {
                                                        $('#lootButtons').remove();
                                                }
                                        });
                                } else {

                                        btn.text(_(name) + ' [' + num + ']');
                                }
                                var curNum = Path.outfit[name];
                                curNum = typeof curNum == 'number' ? curNum : 0;
                                curNum++;
                                Path.outfit[name] = curNum;
                                World.updateSupplies();

                                if (typeof Achievements !== 'undefined') {
                                        if (name === 'bulletproof vest' && !Achievements.isUnlocked('drop_bulletproof_vest')) {
                                                Achievements.unlock('drop_bulletproof_vest');
                                        }

                                }


                                weight = Path.getWeight(name);
                                freeSpace = Path.getFreeSpace();
                        }

                        if(weight > freeSpace && btn.data('numLeft') > 0) {

                                Engine.log('drop menu');
                                $('#dropMenu').remove();
                                var dropMenu = $('<div>').attr('id', 'dropMenu');
                                for(var k in Path.outfit) {
                                        var itemWeight = Path.getWeight(k);
                                        if(itemWeight > 0) {
                                                var numToDrop = Math.ceil((weight - freeSpace) / itemWeight);
                                                if(numToDrop > Path.outfit[k]) {
                                                        numToDrop = Path.outfit[k];
                                                }
                                                if(numToDrop > 0) {
                                                        var dropRow = $('<div>').attr('id', 'drop_' + k.replace(' ', '-'))
                                                                .text(_(k) + ' x' + numToDrop)
                                                                .data('thing', k)
                                                                .data('num', numToDrop)
                                                                .click(Events.dropStuff);
                                                        dropRow.appendTo(dropMenu);
                                                }
                                        }
                                }
                                dropMenu.appendTo(btn);
                                btn.one("mouseleave", function() {
                                        $('#dropMenu').remove();
                                });
                        }
                }
        },

        createFighterDiv: function(chara, hp, maxhp) {
                var fighter = $('<div>').addClass('fighter').text(_(chara)).data('hp', hp).data('maxHp', maxhp).data('refname',chara);
                $('<div>').addClass('hp').text(hp+'/'+maxhp).appendTo(fighter);
                return fighter;
        },

        updateFighterDiv: function(fighter) {
                $('.hp', fighter).text(fighter.data('hp') + '/' + fighter.data('maxHp'));
        },

        startStory: function(scene) {

                var desc = $('#description', Events.eventPanel());
                for(var i in scene.text) {
                        $('<div>').text(scene.text[i]).appendTo(desc);
                }

                if(scene.textarea != null) {
                        $('<textarea>').val(scene.textarea).appendTo(desc);
                }

                if(scene.loot) {
                        Events.drawLoot(scene.loot);
                }

                Events.drawButtons(scene);
        },

        drawButtons: function(scene) {
                var btns = $('#buttons', Events.eventPanel());
                for(var id in scene.buttons) {
                        var info = scene.buttons[id];
                                var b = new Button.Button({
                                        id: id,
                                        text: info.text,
                                        cost: info.cost,
                                        click: Events.buttonClick
                                }).appendTo(btns);
                        if(typeof info.available == 'function' && !info.available()) {
                                Button.setDisabled(b, true);
                        }
                }

                Events.updateButtons();
        },

        updateButtons: function() {
                var btns = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene].buttons;
                for(var bId in btns) {
                        var b = btns[bId];
                        var btnEl = $('#'+bId, Events.eventPanel());
                        if(typeof b.available == 'function' && !b.available()) {
                                Button.setDisabled(btnEl, true);
                        } else if(b.cost) {
                                var disabled = false;
                                for(var store in b.cost) {
                                        var num = Engine.activeModule == World ? Path.outfit[store] : $SM.get('stores["'+store+'"]', true);
                                        if(typeof num != 'number') num = 0;
                                        if(num < b.cost[store]) {

                                                disabled = true;
                                                break;
                                        }
                                }
                                Button.setDisabled(btnEl, disabled);
                        }
                }
        },

        buttonClick: function(btn) {
                var info = Events.activeEvent().scenes[Events.activeScene].buttons[btn.attr('id')];

                var costMod = {};
                if(info.cost) {
                        for(var store in info.cost) {
                                var num = Engine.activeModule == World ? Path.outfit[store] : $SM.get('stores["'+store+'"]', true);
                                if(typeof num != 'number') num = 0;
                                if(num < info.cost[store]) {

                                        return;
                                }
                                costMod[store] = -info.cost[store];
                        }
                        if(Engine.activeModule == World) {
                                for(var k in costMod) {
                                        Path.outfit[k] += costMod[k];
                                }
                                World.updateSupplies();
                        } else {
                                $SM.addM('stores', costMod);
                        }
                }

                if(typeof info.onChoose == 'function') {
                        var textarea = Events.eventPanel().find('textarea');
                        info.onChoose(textarea.length > 0 ? textarea.val() : null);
                }

                if(info.reward) {
                        $SM.addM('stores', info.reward);
                }

                Events.updateButtons();

                if(info.notification) {
                        Notifications.notify(null, info.notification);
                }

                if(info.nextScene) {
                        if(info.nextScene == 'end') {
                                Events.endEvent();
                        } else {
                                var r = Math.random();
                                var lowestMatch = null;
                                for(var i in info.nextScene) {
                                        if(r < i && (lowestMatch == null || i < lowestMatch)) {
                                                lowestMatch = i;
                                        }
                                }
                                if(lowestMatch != null) {
                                        Events.loadScene(info.nextScene[lowestMatch]);
                                        return;
                                }
                                Engine.log('ERROR: no suitable scene found');
                                Events.endEvent();
                        }
                }
        },



    registerEvent: function(event) {

        if (Object.prototype.toString.call(event) === '[object Array]') {
            Events._registerBatch(event);
            return;
        }
        if (!event || typeof event.isAvailable !== 'function') return;
        if (Events.EventPool.indexOf(event) !== -1) return;
        Events.EventPool.push(event);
    },

    _registerBatch: function(arr) {
        if (!arr || !arr.length) return;
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            Events.registerEvent(arr[i]);
        }
    },

    clearEventPool: function() {
        Events.EventPool = [];
    },

    triggerEvent: function() {
        if(Events.activeEvent() == null) {
                var possibleEvents = [];

                var pool = Events.EventPool;
                for(var i = 0, n = pool.length; i < n; i++) {
                        var event = pool[i];
                        if(event && event.isAvailable()) {
                                possibleEvents.push(event);
                        }
                }



                var _mgr = (typeof window !== 'undefined') ? window.DisasterWeightManager : null;
                if(_mgr) {
                        var _verdict = _mgr.choose(possibleEvents);
                        if(_verdict && _verdict.handled) {
                                if(_verdict.event) {
                                        Events.startEvent(_verdict.event);
                                } else {

                                        Events.scheduleNextEvent(0.5);
                                        return;
                                }
                        } else {
                                if(possibleEvents.length == 0) {
                                        Events.scheduleNextEvent(0.5);
                                        return;
                                } else {
                                        var r = Math.floor(Math.random()*(possibleEvents.length));
                                        Events.startEvent(possibleEvents[r]);
                                }
                        }
                } else {
                        if(possibleEvents.length == 0) {
                                Events.scheduleNextEvent(0.5);
                                return;
                        } else {
                                var r2 = Math.floor(Math.random()*(possibleEvents.length));
                                Events.startEvent(possibleEvents[r2]);
                        }
                }
        }

        Events.scheduleNextEvent();
    },

    triggerFight: function() {
        var possibleFights = [];
        for(var i in Events.Encounters) {
                var fight = Events.Encounters[i];
                if(fight.isAvailable()) {
                        possibleFights.push(fight);
                }
        }

                var r = Math.floor(Math.random()*(possibleFights.length));
        Events.startEvent(possibleFights[r]);
    },

        activeEvent: function() {
                if(Events.eventStack && Events.eventStack.length > 0) {
                        return Events.eventStack[0];
                }
                return null;
        },

        eventPanel: function() {
                return Events.activeEvent().eventPanel;
        },

    startEvent: function(event, options) {
                if(event) {

                        if(Events.activeEvent() != null) {
                                if(options && options.replace) {
                                        Events.activeEvent().eventPanel.remove();
                                        Events.activeEvent().eventPanel = null;
                                        Events.eventStack.shift();
                                        Engine.keyLock = false;
                                } else {
                                        return;
                                }
                        }
                        Engine.event('game event', 'event');
                        Engine.keyLock = true;
                        Events.eventStack.unshift(event);
                        event.eventPanel = $('<div>').attr('id', 'event').addClass('eventPanel').css('opacity', '0');
                        if(options != null && options.width != null) {
                                Events.eventPanel().css('width', options.width);
                        }
                        $('<div>').addClass('eventTitle').text(Events.activeEvent().title).appendTo(Events.eventPanel());
                        $('<div>').attr('id', 'description').appendTo(Events.eventPanel());
                        $('<div>').attr('id', 'buttons').appendTo(Events.eventPanel());
                        Events.loadScene('start');
                        $('div#wrapper').append(Events.eventPanel());
                        Events.eventPanel().animate({opacity: 1}, Events._PANEL_FADE, 'linear');
                }
    },

    scheduleNextEvent: function(scale) {
        var nextEvent = Math.floor(Math.random()*(Events._EVENT_TIME_RANGE[1] - Events._EVENT_TIME_RANGE[0])) + Events._EVENT_TIME_RANGE[0];
        if(scale > 0) { nextEvent *= scale; }
        Engine.log('next event scheduled in ' + nextEvent + ' minutes');
        Events._eventTimeout = setTimeout(Events.triggerEvent, nextEvent * 60 * 1000);
    },

    endEvent: function() {

        Events.clearPoison();
        $('#wanderer').removeData('stunned');
        Events.eventPanel().animate({opacity:0}, Events._PANEL_FADE, 'linear', function() {
                Events.eventPanel().remove();
                        Events.activeEvent().eventPanel = null;
                        Events.eventStack.shift();
                Engine.log(Events.eventStack.length + ' events remaining');
                Engine.keyLock = false;

                $('body').focus();
        });
    },

    handleStateUpdates: function(e){
                if(e.category == 'stores' && Events.activeEvent() != null){
                        Events.updateButtons();
                }
        }
};
        </script>
