                                } else if(!World.starvation) {
                                        Notifications.notify(World, _('starvation sets in'));
                                        World.starvation = true;
                                } else {
                                        $SM.set('character.starved', $SM.get('character.starved', true));
                                        $SM.add('character.starved', 1);
                                        if($SM.get('character.starved') >= 10 && !$SM.hasPerk('slow metabolism')) {
                                                $SM.addPerk('slow metabolism');
                                        }
                                        World.die();
                                        return false;
                                }
                        } else {
                                World.starvation = false;
                                World.setHp(World.health + World.meatHeal());
                        }
                        Path.outfit['cured meat'] = num;
                }

                var movesPerWater = World.MOVES_PER_WATER;
                movesPerWater *= $SM.hasPerk('desert rat') ? 2 : 1;
                if(World.waterMove >= movesPerWater) {
                        World.waterMove = 0;
                        var water = World.water;
                        water--;
                        if(water == 0) {
                                Notifications.notify(World, _('there is no more water'));
                        } else if(water < 0) {
                                water = 0;

                                var _brains = Path.outfit['animal brains'];
                                if(typeof _brains == 'number' && _brains > 0) {
                                        Path.outfit['animal brains'] = _brains - 1;
                                        World.thirst = false;
                                        World.updateSupplies();
                                        World.eatForbiddenOrgan('animal brains');
                                } else if(!World.thirst) {
                                        Notifications.notify(World, _('the thirst becomes unbearable'));
                                        World.thirst = true;
                                } else {
                                        $SM.set('character.dehydrated', $SM.get('character.dehydrated', true));
                                        $SM.add('character.dehydrated', 1);
                                        if($SM.get('character.dehydrated') >= 10 && !$SM.hasPerk('desert rat')) {
                                                $SM.addPerk('desert rat');
                                        }
                                        World.die();
                                        return false;
                                }
                        } else {
                                World.thirst = false;
                        }
                        World.setWater(water);
                        World.updateSupplies();
                }
                return true;
        },

        meatHeal: function() {
                return World.MEAT_HEAL * ($SM.hasPerk('gastronome') ? 2 : 1);
        },

        medsHeal: function() {
                return World.MEDS_HEAL;
        },

        checkFight: function() {
                World.fightMove = typeof World.fightMove == 'number' ? World.fightMove : 0;
                World.fightMove++;
                if(World.fightMove > World.FIGHT_DELAY) {
                        var chance = World.FIGHT_CHANCE;
                        chance *= $SM.hasPerk('stealthy') ? 0.5 : 1;
                        if(Math.random() < chance) {
                                World.fightMove = 0;
                                Events.triggerFight();
                        }
                }
        },

        doSpace: function() {
                var curTile = World.state.map[World.curPos[0]][World.curPos[1]];

                if(curTile == World.TILE.VILLAGE) {
                        World.goHome();
                } else if(typeof World.LANDMARKS[curTile] != 'undefined') {
                        if(curTile != World.TILE.OUTPOST || !World.outpostUsed()) {
                                Events.startEvent(Events.Setpieces[World.LANDMARKS[curTile].scene]);
                        }
                } else {
                        if(World.useSupplies()) {
                                World.checkFight();
                        }
                }
        },

        getDistance: function(from, to) {
                from = from || World.curPos;
                to = to || World.VILLAGE_POS;
                return Math.abs(from[0] - to[0]) + Math.abs(from[1] - to[1]);
        },

        getTerrain: function() {
                return World.state.map[World.curPos[0]][World.curPos[1]];
        },

        narrateMove: function(oldTile, newTile) {
                var msg = null;
                switch(oldTile) {
                        case World.TILE.FOREST:
                                switch(newTile) {
                                        case World.TILE.FIELD:
                                                msg = _("the trees yield to dry grass. the yellowed brush rustles in the wind.");
                                                break;
                                        case World.TILE.BARRENS:
                                                msg = _("the trees are gone. parched earth and blowing dust are poor replacements.");
                                                break;
                                }
                                break;
                        case World.TILE.FIELD:
                                switch(newTile) {
                                        case World.TILE.FOREST:
                                                msg = _("trees loom on the horizon. grasses gradually yield to a forest floor of dry branches and fallen leaves.");
                                                break;
                                        case World.TILE.BARRENS:
                                                msg = _("the grasses thin. soon, only dust remains.");
                                                break;
                                }
                                break;
                        case World.TILE.BARRENS:
                                switch(newTile) {
                                        case World.TILE.FIELD:
                                                msg = _("the barrens break at a sea of dying grass, swaying in the arid breeze.");
                                                break;
                                        case World.TILE.FOREST:
                                                msg = _("a wall of gnarled trees rises from the dust. their branches twist into a skeletal canopy overhead.");
                                                break;
                                }
                                break;
                }
                if(msg != null) {
                        Notifications.notify(World, msg);
                }
        },

        newMask: function() {
                var mask = new Array(World.RADIUS * 2 + 1);
                for(var i = 0; i <= World.RADIUS * 2; i++) {
                        mask[i] = new Array(World.RADIUS * 2 + 1);
                }
                World.lightMap(World.RADIUS, World.RADIUS, mask);
                return mask;
        },

        lightMap: function(x, y, mask) {
                var r = World.LIGHT_RADIUS;

                r *= $SM.hasPerk('scout') ? (11 / World.LIGHT_RADIUS) : 1;
                World.uncoverMap(x, y, r, mask);
                return mask;
        },

        uncoverMap: function(x, y, r, mask) {
                mask[x][y] = true;
                for(var i = -r; i <= r; i++) {
                        for(var j = -r + Math.abs(i); j <= r - Math.abs(i); j++) {
                                if(y + j >= 0 && y + j <= World.RADIUS * 2 &&
                                                x + i <= World.RADIUS * 2 &&
                                                x + i >= 0) {
                                        mask[x+i][y+j] = true;
                                }
                        }
                }
        },

        generateMap: function() {
                var map = new Array(World.RADIUS * 2 + 1);
                for(var i = 0; i <= World.RADIUS * 2; i++) {
                        map[i] = new Array(World.RADIUS * 2 + 1);
                }

                map[World.RADIUS][World.RADIUS] = World.TILE.VILLAGE;
                for(var r = 1; r <= World.RADIUS; r++) {
                        for(var t = 0; t < r * 8; t++) {
                                var x, y;
                                if(t < 2 * r) {
                                        x = World.RADIUS - r + t;
                                        y = World.RADIUS - r;
                                } else if(t < 4 * r) {
                                        x = World.RADIUS + r;
                                        y = World.RADIUS - (3 * r) + t;
                                } else if(t < 6 * r) {
                                        x = World.RADIUS + (5 * r) - t;
                                        y = World.RADIUS + r;
                                } else {
                                        x = World.RADIUS - r;
                                        y = World.RADIUS + (7 * r) - t;
                                }

                                map[x][y] = World.chooseTile(x, y, map);
                        }
                }



                for(var k in World.LANDMARKS) {
                        var landmark = World.LANDMARKS[k];

                        if (landmark.num > 0 && landmark.layer) {
                                for (var i = 0; i < landmark.num; i++) {
                                        if (landmark.chance != null && Math.random() >= landmark.chance) continue;
                                        var pos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer(landmark.layer, k, map);
                                        if (k == World.TILE.SHIP) {
                                                var dx = pos[0] - World.RADIUS, dy = pos[1] - World.RADIUS;
                                                var horz = dx < 0 ? 'west' : 'east';
                                                var vert = dy < 0 ? 'north' : 'south';
                                                if (Math.abs(dx) / 2 > Math.abs(dy)) {
                                                        World.dir = horz;
                                                } else if (Math.abs(dy) / 2 > Math.abs(dx)) {
                                                        World.dir = vert;
                                                } else {
                                                        World.dir = vert + horz;
                                                }
                                        }
                                }
                        }

                        if (landmark.layer2Num > 0) {
                                for (var i = 0; i < landmark.layer2Num; i++) {
                                        if (landmark.chance != null && Math.random() >= landmark.chance) continue;
                                        World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', k, map);
                                }
                        }

                        if (landmark.layer3Num > 0) {
                                for (var i = 0; i < landmark.layer3Num; i++) {
                                        if (landmark.chance != null && Math.random() >= landmark.chance) continue;
                                        World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L3', k, map);
                                }
                        }

                        if (!landmark.layer && landmark.num > 0) {
                                for (var i = 0; i < landmark.num; i++) {
                                        if (landmark.chance != null && Math.random() >= landmark.chance) continue;
                                        World.placeLandmark(landmark.minRadius, landmark.maxRadius, k, map);
                                }
                        }
                }


                var _treasureN = World._placeTreasures(map, World._treasureCount());
                if(typeof Engine != 'undefined' && Engine.log) Engine.log('treasures placed: ' + _treasureN);

                return map;
        },

        placeLandmark: function(minRadius, maxRadius, landmark, map) {

                var x = World.RADIUS, y = World.RADIUS;
                while(!World.isTerrain(map[x][y])) {
                        var r = Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxRadius - minRadius)) + minRadius;
                        var xDist = Math.floor(Math.random() * r);
                        var yDist = r - xDist;
                        if(Math.random() < 0.5) xDist = -xDist;
                        if(Math.random() < 0.5) yDist = -yDist;
                        x = World.RADIUS + xDist;
                        if(x < 0) x = 0;
                        if(x > World.RADIUS * 2) x = World.RADIUS * 2;
                        y = World.RADIUS + yDist;
                        if(y < 0) y = 0;
                        if(y > World.RADIUS * 2) y = World.RADIUS * 2;
                }
                map[x][y] = landmark;
                return [x, y];
        },





        placeLandmarkByLayer: function(layer, landmark, map, avoidCoords) {
                var x = World.RADIUS, y = World.RADIUS;
                var attempts = 0;
                var maxAttempts = 1000;
                while(attempts < maxAttempts) {
                        attempts++;
                        var pos = World._pickLayerCell(layer);
                        if (!pos) break;
                        x = pos[0]; y = pos[1];

                        if(!World.isTerrain(map[x][y])) continue;

                        if (avoidCoords && avoidCoords.length > 0) {
                                var tooClose = false;
                                for (var i = 0; i < avoidCoords.length; i++) {
                                        var ax = avoidCoords[i][0], ay = avoidCoords[i][1];
                                        if (Math.max(Math.abs(x - ax), Math.abs(y - ay)) <= 3) {
                                                tooClose = true; break;
                                        }
                                }
                                if (tooClose) continue;
                        }
                        break;
                }
                map[x][y] = landmark;
                return [x, y];
        },

        _pickLayerCell: function(layer) {
                var cx = World.VILLAGE_POS[0], cy = World.VILLAGE_POS[1];
                var dx, dy;
                if (layer === 'L1') {

                        dx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (2 * World.LAYER1_RADIUS + 1)) - World.LAYER1_RADIUS;
                        dy = Math.floor(Math.random() * (2 * World.LAYER1_RADIUS + 1)) - World.LAYER1_RADIUS;
                        if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) dx = 1;
                } else if (layer === 'L2') {

                        var inner = World.LAYER2_INNER, outer = World.LAYER2_OUTER;

                        var r = Math.floor(Math.random() * (outer - inner + 1)) + inner;

                        var perimeter = 8 * r;
                        var t = Math.floor(Math.random() * perimeter);
                        if(t < 2 * r) {
                                dx = -r + t; dy = -r;
                        } else if(t < 4 * r) {
                                dx = r; dy = -3*r + t;
                        } else if(t < 6 * r) {
                                dx = 5*r - t; dy = r;
                        } else {
                                dx = -r; dy = 7*r - t;
                        }
                } else if (layer === 'L3') {

                        var innerL3 = World.LAYER3_INNER, outerL3 = World.RADIUS;
                        var r = Math.floor(Math.random() * (outerL3 - innerL3 + 1)) + innerL3;
                        var perimeter = 8 * r;
                        var t = Math.floor(Math.random() * perimeter);
                        if(t < 2 * r) {
                                dx = -r + t; dy = -r;
                        } else if(t < 4 * r) {
                                dx = r; dy = -3*r + t;
                        } else if(t < 6 * r) {
                                dx = 5*r - t; dy = r;
                        } else {
                                dx = -r; dy = 7*r - t;
                        }
                } else {
                        return null;
                }
                var x = cx + dx, y = cy + dy;
                if (x < 0) x = 0;
                if (x > World.RADIUS * 2) x = World.RADIUS * 2;
                if (y < 0) y = 0;
                if (y > World.RADIUS * 2) y = World.RADIUS * 2;
                return [x, y];
        },


        pickLayer2Cell: function(avoidCoords) {
                var attempts = 0, maxAttempts = 500;
                while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
                        attempts++;
                        var pos = World._pickLayerCell('L2');
                        if (!pos) return null;
                        if (avoidCoords && avoidCoords.length > 0) {
                                var tooClose = false;
                                for (var i = 0; i < avoidCoords.length; i++) {
                                        var ax = avoidCoords[i][0], ay = avoidCoords[i][1];
                                        if (Math.max(Math.abs(pos[0] - ax), Math.abs(pos[1] - ay)) <= 3) {
                                                tooClose = true; break;
                                        }
                                }
                                if (tooClose) continue;
                        }
                        return pos;
                }
                return null;
        },

        _findTileInMap: function(map, tile) {
                if (!map) return null;
                var max = World.RADIUS * 2;

                var cx = World.VILLAGE_POS[0], cy = World.VILLAGE_POS[1];
                var inner = World.LAYER2_INNER, outer = World.LAYER2_OUTER;
                for (var dx = -outer; dx <= outer; dx++) {
                        var x = cx + dx;
                        if (x < 0 || x > max) continue;
                        var row = map[x];
                        if (!row) continue;
                        for (var dy = -outer; dy <= outer; dy++) {
                                var y = cy + dy;
                                if (y < 0 || y > max) continue;
                                if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < inner) continue;
                                if (row[y] === tile) return [x, y];
                        }
                }
                return null;
        },

        isTerrain: function(tile) {
                return tile == World.TILE.FOREST || tile == World.TILE.FIELD || tile == World.TILE.BARRENS;
        },

        chooseTile: function(x, y, map) {


                var row = map[x];
                var n = (y > 0)                  ? row[y-1] : null;
                var s = (y < World.RADIUS * 2)   ? row[y+1] : null;
                var e = (x < World.RADIUS * 2)   ? map[x+1][y] : null;
                var w = (x > 0)                  ? map[x-1][y] : null;

                if (n === World.TILE.VILLAGE || s === World.TILE.VILLAGE ||
                    e === World.TILE.VILLAGE || w === World.TILE.VILLAGE) {
                        return World.TILE.FOREST;
                }

                var chances = {};
                var nonSticky = 1;

                if (typeof n === 'string') { chances[n] = (chances[n] || 0) + World.STICKINESS; nonSticky -= World.STICKINESS; }
                if (typeof s === 'string') { chances[s] = (chances[s] || 0) + World.STICKINESS; nonSticky -= World.STICKINESS; }
                if (typeof e === 'string') { chances[e] = (chances[e] || 0) + World.STICKINESS; nonSticky -= World.STICKINESS; }
                if (typeof w === 'string') { chances[w] = (chances[w] || 0) + World.STICKINESS; nonSticky -= World.STICKINESS; }

                chances[World.TILE.FOREST]  = (chances[World.TILE.FOREST]  || 0) + World.TILE_PROBS[World.TILE.FOREST]  * nonSticky;
                chances[World.TILE.FIELD]   = (chances[World.TILE.FIELD]   || 0) + World.TILE_PROBS[World.TILE.FIELD]   * nonSticky;
                chances[World.TILE.BARRENS] = (chances[World.TILE.BARRENS] || 0) + World.TILE_PROBS[World.TILE.BARRENS] * nonSticky;

                var list = [];
                for (var t in chances) list.push([chances[t], t]);
                list.sort(function(a, b) { return b[0] - a[0]; });

                var c = 0, r = Math.random();
                for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                        c += list[i][0];
                        if (r < c) return list[i][1];
                }
                return World.TILE.BARRENS;
        },

        markVisited: function(x, y) {

                World.state.map[x][y] = World.state.map[x][y] + '!';
                if (World.state.visited) World.state.visited[x + ',' + y] = '!';

                if (typeof World.buildMiniMap === 'function') {
                        World.drawMap();
                        World.buildMiniMap();
                        World.updateMiniMap();
                }
        },



        isLandmarkDepleted: function(c) {
                if (c === World.TILE.POWER_STATION) {
                        return $SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true) ? true : false;
                }
                if (c === World.TILE.WATER_PLANT) {
                        return $SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpObtained', true) ? true : false;
                }
                return false;
        },

        depletedLabel: function(c) {
                if (c === World.TILE.POWER_STATION) return _('废弃的发电站 (已清空)');
                if (c === World.TILE.WATER_PLANT) return _('abandoned water plant (cleared)');
                return (World.LANDMARKS[c] && World.LANDMARKS[c].label) || '';
        },







        _treasureCount: function() {
                var cfg = World.TREASURE || {};
                var lo = (cfg.countMin != null) ? cfg.countMin : 250;
                var hi = (cfg.countMax != null) ? cfg.countMax : 300;
                if (hi < lo) hi = lo;

                return lo + Math.floor(Math.random() * (hi - lo + 1));
        },

        _rollTerrain: function() {
                var r = Math.random(), acc = 0;
                for (var k in World.TILE_PROBS) {
                        acc += World.TILE_PROBS[k];
                        if (r < acc) return k;
                }
                return World.TILE.BARRENS;
        },

        _placeTreasures: function(map, count) {
                if (!map || !count || count <= 0) return 0;
                var R = World.RADIUS, size = R * 2 + 1;
                var cfg = World.TREASURE || {};
                var minR = (cfg.minRadius != null) ? cfg.minRadius : 10;

                var G = (cfg.gridDensity != null) ? cfg.gridDensity : 18;
                if (G < 1) G = 1;
                var cw = Math.ceil(size / G);
                var cells = [];
                for (var gy = 0; gy < G; gy++) {
                        for (var gx = 0; gx < G; gx++) cells.push([gx, gy]);
                }

                for (var i = cells.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                        var jx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                        var tmp = cells[i]; cells[i] = cells[jx]; cells[jx] = tmp;
                }
                var placed = 0, ci = 0, guard = 0, maxGuard = count * 50;
                while (placed < count && guard < maxGuard) {
                        guard++;
                        var cell = cells[ci % cells.length]; ci++;

                        var x = cell[0] * cw + Math.floor(Math.random() * cw);
                        var y = cell[1] * cw + Math.floor(Math.random() * cw);
                        if (x >= size) x = size - 1;
                        if (y >= size) y = size - 1;

                        if (Math.abs(x - R) + Math.abs(y - R) < minR) continue;

                        if (World.isTerrain(map[x][y])) {
                                map[x][y] = World.TILE.TREASURE;
                                placed++;
                        }
                }
                return placed;
        },

        countTreasures: function(map) {
                if (!map) return 0;
                var R = World.RADIUS * 2, n = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i <= R; i++) {
                        var row = map[i];
                        if (!row) continue;
                        for (var j = 0; j <= R; j++) {
                                if (row[j] === World.TILE.TREASURE) n++;
                        }
                }
                return n;
        },

        mapHasTreasure: function(map) {
                return World.countTreasures(map) > 0;
        },

        seedTreasuresIfNeeded: function() {
                try {
                        if (!World.state || !World.state.map) return;

                        if ($SM.get('game.treasureSeededV2', true)) return;
                        var existing = World.countTreasures(World.state.map);
                        var target = World._treasureCount();
                        if (existing < target) {
                                var n = target - existing;
                                var placedN = World._placeTreasures(World.state.map, n);
                                Engine.log('treasure top-up: +' + placedN + ' (existing ' + existing + ', target ' + target + ')');
                        }
                        $SM.set('game.treasureSeededV2', true);
                } catch (e) {
                        if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('seedTreasuresIfNeeded error:', e);
                }
        },

        removeTreasureAt: function(pos) {
                if (!World.state || !World.state.map || !pos) return;
                var x = pos[0], y = pos[1];
                if (World.state.map[x][y] !== World.TILE.TREASURE) return;

                World.state.map[x][y] = World._rollTerrain();

                var key = x + ',' + y;
                if (World.state.discoveredLandmarks && World.state.discoveredLandmarks[key]) {
                        delete World.state.discoveredLandmarks[key];
                }

                World.drawMap();
                if (typeof World.buildMiniMap === 'function' && $('#miniMap').length > 0) {
                        World.buildMiniMap();
                        World.updateMiniMap();
                }
        },

        rollTreasureLoot: function() {

                var entries = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < World.TREASURE_LOOT.length; i++) {
                        entries.push([World.TREASURE_LOOT[i], World.TREASURE_LOOT[i].weight]);
                }
                var pick = (typeof DisasterWeightManager !== 'undefined' && DisasterWeightManager.weightedPick) ?
                        DisasterWeightManager.weightedPick(entries) : entries[Math.floor(Math.random() * entries.length)][0];

                if (pick.type === 'weapon') {
                        var wEntries = [];
                        for (var j = 0; j < World.TREASURE_WEAPONS.length; j++) {
                                wEntries.push([World.TREASURE_WEAPONS[j].key, World.TREASURE_WEAPONS[j].weight]);
                        }
                        var wKey;
                        if (typeof DisasterWeightManager !== 'undefined' && DisasterWeightManager.weightedPick) {
                                wKey = DisasterWeightManager.weightedPick(wEntries);
                        } else {
                                wKey = wEntries[Math.floor(Math.random() * wEntries.length)][0];
                        }
                        return { type: 'weapon', key: wKey, num: 1 };
                }
                if (pick.type === 'water') {
                        return { type: 'water' };
                }
                var num = Math.floor(Math.random() * (pick.max - pick.min)) + pick.min;
                return { type: pick.type, key: pick.type, num: num };
        },




        BEAST_ENEMIES: [
                'beast', 'snarling beast', 'strange bird', 'bird',
                'lizard', 'lizards', 'cave lizard',
                'rats', 'mutant rat swarm', 'mutant giant rat',
                'tentacles', 'man-eater', 'feral terror', 'beastly matriarch', 'deformed',
                'polluted beast', 'pipe crawler'
        ],

        isBeastEnemy: function(enemy) {
                return typeof enemy == 'string' && World.BEAST_ENEMIES.indexOf(enemy) >= 0;
        },

        addBeastDrops: function(loot) {
                if (!loot) loot = {};
                if (typeof loot['animal organs'] == 'undefined') {
                        loot['animal organs'] = { min: 1, max: 4, chance: 0.4 };
                }
                if (typeof loot['animal brains'] == 'undefined') {
                        loot['animal brains'] = { min: 1, max: 3, chance: 0.35 };
                }
                return loot;
        },



        eatForbiddenOrgan: function(item) {
                if (item == 'animal organs') {
                        Notifications.notify(World, _('腊肉吃光了, 你硬着头皮咽下了一块动物内脏.'));
                } else {
                        Notifications.notify(World, _('水喝完了, 你闭上眼睛吞下了一团动物脑浆.'));
                }
                Notifications.notify(World, _('生腥的味道在胃里炸开, 你开始感到一阵眩晕.'));
                var tick = 0;
                var timer = setInterval(function() {

                        if (!World.state || World.dead) {
                                clearInterval(timer);
                                return;
                        }
                        var newHp = World.health - 2;
                        if (newHp <= 0) {

                                clearInterval(timer);
                                World.setHp(0);
                                if (typeof Events !== 'undefined' && Events.activeEvent()) {
                                        if (Events._enemyAttackTimer) clearTimeout(Events._enemyAttackTimer);
                                        try { Events.endEvent(); } catch (e) {}
                                }
                                World.die();
                                return;
                        }
                        World.setHp(newHp);

                        if (typeof Events !== 'undefined' && Events.activeEvent()) {
                                var w = $('#wanderer');
                                if (w.length) {
                                        w.data('hp', World.health);
                                        if (typeof Events.updateFighterDiv == 'function') Events.updateFighterDiv(w);
                                }
                        }
                        tick++;
                        if (tick >= 3) clearInterval(timer);
                }, 1000);
        },

        SUPPLY_DESC: {
                'animal organs': '暗红紫褐交织，覆白筋膜与黄脂肪，湿润黏滑，腥膻刺鼻，带血水.',
                'animal brains': '灰粉色半凝固胶状，覆半透明脑膜，夹暗红血丝，湿润黏滑，腥咸带铁锈味.'
        },

        showSupplyDesc: function(el, name) {

                var existing = $('#supplyDescMenu');
                if (existing.length > 0) {
                        var wasSame = (existing.data('owner') === el);
                        existing.remove();
                        if (wasSame) return;
                }
                var desc = World.SUPPLY_DESC[name];
                if (!desc) return;
                var $el = $(el);
                var menu = $('<div>').attr('id', 'supplyDescMenu')
                        .text(_(desc))
                        .data('owner', el)
                        .appendTo('body');

                var off = $el.offset();
                var left = Math.max(4, Math.min(off.left - 30, $(window).width() - menu.outerWidth() - 4));
                menu.css({ left: left + 'px', top: (off.top + $el.outerHeight() + 4) + 'px' });

                setTimeout(function() {
                        $(document).one('click.supplydesc', function(ev) {
                                if ($(ev.target).closest('#supplyDescMenu').length == 0) {
                                        menu.remove();
                                }
                        });
                }, 30);
        },

        drawMap: function() {


                var map = $('#map');
                if(map.length == 0) {
                        map = new $('<div>').attr('id', 'map').appendTo('#worldOuter');

                        map.click(World.click);

                        $('<div>').attr('id', 'mapInner').appendTo(map);
                        $('<canvas>').attr('id', 'mainMapFog').appendTo(map);
                }
                var mapInner = $('#mapInner');
                if(mapInner.length == 0) {
                        mapInner = $('<div>').attr('id', 'mapInner').appendTo(map);
                }
                if($('#mainMapFog').length == 0) {
                        $('<canvas>').attr('id', 'mainMapFog').appendTo(map);
                }

                if(!World.state || !World.state.map) {
                        mapInner.html('');
                        return;
                }


                var _mapWPx = (World.RADIUS * 2 + 1) * World.TILE_PX_X;
                var _mapHPx = (World.RADIUS * 2 + 1) * World.TILE_PX_Y;
                var _maxCamX = Math.max(0, _mapWPx - World.VIEWPORT_W);
                var _maxCamY = Math.max(0, _mapHPx - World.VIEWPORT_H);
                if (!isFinite(World.camX) || World.camX < 0) World.camX = 0;
                if (!isFinite(World.camY) || World.camY < 0) World.camY = 0;
                if (World.camX > _maxCamX) World.camX = _maxCamX;
                if (World.camY > _maxCamY) World.camY = _maxCamY;

                var R = World.RADIUS * 2;
                var camTileX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(World.camX / World.TILE_PX_X));
                var camTileY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(World.camY / World.TILE_PX_Y));
                var endTileX = Math.min(R, Math.ceil((World.camX + World.VIEWPORT_W) / World.TILE_PX_X));
                var endTileY = Math.min(R, Math.ceil((World.camY + World.VIEWPORT_H) / World.TILE_PX_Y));

                var mapString = "";
                for(var j = camTileY; j <= endTileY; j++) {
                        for(var i = camTileX; i <= endTileX; i++) {
                                var ttClass = "";
                                if(i > World.RADIUS) {
                                        ttClass += " left";
                                } else {
                                        ttClass += " right";
                                }
                                if(j > World.RADIUS) {
                                        ttClass += " top";
                                } else {
                                        ttClass += " bottom";
                                }
                                if(World.curPos[0] == i && World.curPos[1] == j) {
                                        mapString += '<span class="landmark">@<div class="tooltip ' + ttClass + '">'+_('Wanderer')+'</div></span>';
                                } else {
                                        var c = World.state.map[i][j];
                                        switch(c) {
                                                case World.TILE.VILLAGE:
                                                        mapString += '<span class="landmark">' + c + '<div class="tooltip' + ttClass + '">'+_('The Village')+'</div></span>';
                                                        break;
                                                default:
                                                        if(typeof World.LANDMARKS[c] != 'undefined' && (c != World.TILE.OUTPOST || !World.outpostUsed(i, j))) {

                                                                var _dead = World.isLandmarkDepleted(c);
                                                                mapString += '<span class="landmark' + (_dead ? ' depleted' : '') + '">' + c + '<div class="tooltip' + ttClass + '">' + (_dead ? World.depletedLabel(c) : World.LANDMARKS[c].label) + '</div></span>';
                                                        } else {
                                                                if(c && c.length > 1) {
                                                                        c = c[0];
                                                                }
                                                                mapString += c ? c : '&nbsp;';
                                                        }
                                                        break;
                                        }
                                }
                        }
                        mapString += '\n';
                }
                mapInner.html(mapString);

                var offX = -(World.camX - camTileX * World.TILE_PX_X);
                var offY = -(World.camY - camTileY * World.TILE_PX_Y);
                mapInner.css({ left: offX + 'px', top: offY + 'px' });
        },

        die: function() {
                if(!World.dead) {
                        World.dead = true;





                        try {
                                if (typeof Achievements !== 'undefined' && !Achievements.isUnlocked('first_death')) {
                                        try {
                                                Achievements.unlock('first_death');
                                        } catch(_e1) {

                                                if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('first_death sync unlock failed:', _e1);
                                                setTimeout(function() {
                                                        try { Achievements.unlock('first_death'); } catch(_e2) {
                                                                if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('first_death async retry failed:', _e2);
                                                        }
                                                }, 50);
                                        }
                                }

                                if (!$SM.get('character.firstDeath')) $SM.set('character.firstDeath', true);
                        } catch(_achErr) {
                                if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('first_death achievement error:', _achErr);
                        }
                        Engine.log('player death');
                        Engine.event('game event', 'death');
                        Engine.keyLock = true;



                        Notifications.notify(World, _('the world fades'));
                        if (World.state) {
                                try {
                                        var _toSave = {};
                                        for (var k in World.state) {
                                                if (k !== 'map' && k !== 'mask' && k !== 'mapC' && k !== 'maskC' && k !== 'mapZ' && k !== 'maskZ') _toSave[k] = World.state[k];
                                        }

                                        _toSave.mapZ = World.compressMapZ(World.state.map);
                                        _toSave.maskZ = World.compressMaskZ(World.state.mask);
                                        _toSave.compressed = true;
                                        $SM.setM('game.world', _toSave);

                                        if(World.state.sulphurmine && $SM.get('game.buildings["sulphur mine"]', true) == 0) {
                                                $SM.add('game.buildings["sulphur mine"]', 1);
                                                Engine.event('progress', 'sulphur mine');
                                        }
                                        if(World.state.ironmine && $SM.get('game.buildings["iron mine"]', true) == 0) {
                                                $SM.add('game.buildings["iron mine"]', 1);
                                                Engine.event('progress', 'iron mine');
                                        }
                                        if(World.state.coalmine && $SM.get('game.buildings["coal mine"]', true) == 0) {
                                                $SM.add('game.buildings["coal mine"]', 1);
                                                Engine.event('progress', 'coal mine');
                                        }
                                        if(World.state.ship && !$SM.get('features.location.spaceShip')) {
                                                Ship.init();
                                                Engine.event('progress', 'ship');
                                        }
                                } catch(e) {
                                        Engine.log('death save failed: ' + e);
                                }
                        }
                        World.state = null;
                        Path.outfit = {};

                        World.hideMiniMapUI();
                        $('#outerSlider').animate({opacity: '0'}, 600, 'linear', function() {
                                $('#outerSlider').css('left', '0px');
                                $('#locationSlider').css('left', '0px');
                                $('#storesContainer').css({'top': '0px', 'right': '0px'});
                                Engine.activeModule = Room;
                                $('div.headerButton').removeClass('selected');
                                Room.tab.addClass('selected');
                                setTimeout(function(){
                                        Room.onArrival();
                                        $('#outerSlider').animate({opacity:'1'}, 600, 'linear');
                                        Button.cooldown($('#embarkButton'));
                                        Engine.keyLock = false;
                                }, 2000);
                        });
                }
        },

        goHome: function() {


                var _toSave = {};
                for (var k in World.state) {
                        if (k !== 'map' && k !== 'mask' && k !== 'mapC' && k !== 'maskC' && k !== 'mapZ' && k !== 'maskZ') _toSave[k] = World.state[k];
                }
                _toSave.mapZ = World.compressMapZ(World.state.map);
                _toSave.maskZ = World.compressMaskZ(World.state.mask);
                _toSave.compressed = true;
                $SM.setM('game.world', _toSave);
                if(World.state.sulphurmine && $SM.get('game.buildings["sulphur mine"]', true) == 0) {
                        $SM.add('game.buildings["sulphur mine"]', 1);
                        Engine.event('progress', 'sulphur mine');
                }
                if(World.state.ironmine && $SM.get('game.buildings["iron mine"]', true) == 0) {
                        $SM.add('game.buildings["iron mine"]', 1);
                        Engine.event('progress', 'iron mine');
                }
                if(World.state.coalmine && $SM.get('game.buildings["coal mine"]', true) == 0) {
                        $SM.add('game.buildings["coal mine"]', 1);
                        Engine.event('progress', 'coal mine');
                }
                if(World.state.ship && !$SM.get('features.location.spaceShip')) {
                        Ship.init();
                        Engine.event('progress', 'ship');
                }
                World.state = null;

                World.hideMiniMapUI();

                var btn = Button.clearCooldown($('#embarkButton'));
                if(Path.outfit['cured meat'] > 0) {
                        Button.setDisabled(btn, false);
                }

                for(var k in Path.outfit) {
                        $SM.add('stores["'+k+'"]', Path.outfit[k]);
                        if(World.leaveItAtHome(k)) {
                                Path.outfit[k] = 0;
                        }
                }

                if (typeof PowerStation !== 'undefined') {
                        PowerStation.onGoHome();
                }

                if (typeof WaterStation !== 'undefined') {
                        WaterStation.onGoHome();
                }

                $('#outerSlider').animate({left: '0px'}, 300);
                Engine.activeModule = Path;
                Path.onArrival();
        },

        leaveItAtHome: function(thing) {

                 return thing != 'cured meat' && thing != 'bullets' && thing != 'energy cell'  && thing != 'charm' && thing != 'medicine' && thing != 'disinfectant'
                         && typeof World.Weapons[thing] == 'undefined' && typeof Room.Craftables[thing] == 'undefined';
        },

        getMaxHealth: function() {
                var selectedArmour = $SM.get('game.selectedArmour') || 'auto';
                if(selectedArmour === 'auto') {

                        if($SM.get('stores["s armour"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 35;
                        } else if($SM.get('stores["bulletproof vest"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 25;
                        } else if($SM.get('stores["i armour"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 15;
                        } else if($SM.get('stores["l armour"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 5;
                        }
                        return World.BASE_HEALTH;
                }

                var armour = World.Armours[selectedArmour];
                if(armour && $SM.get('stores["'+selectedArmour+'"]', true) > 0) {
                        return World.BASE_HEALTH + armour.bonus;
                }

                        if($SM.get('stores["s armour"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 35;
                        } else if($SM.get('stores["bulletproof vest"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 25;
                        } else if($SM.get('stores["i armour"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 15;
                        } else if($SM.get('stores["l armour"]', true) > 0) {
                                return World.BASE_HEALTH + 5;
                        }
                        return World.BASE_HEALTH;
        },

        getEffectiveArmour: function() {
                var selectedArmour = $SM.get('game.selectedArmour') || 'auto';
                if(selectedArmour !== 'auto') {
                        if(World.Armours[selectedArmour] && $SM.get('stores["'+selectedArmour+'"]', true) > 0) {
                                return selectedArmour;
                        }
                }

                if($SM.get('stores["s armour"]', true) > 0) return 's armour';
                if($SM.get('stores["bulletproof vest"]', true) > 0) return 'bulletproof vest';
                if($SM.get('stores["i armour"]', true) > 0) return 'i armour';
                if($SM.get('stores["l armour"]', true) > 0) return 'l armour';
                return 'none';
        },

        getHitChance: function() {
                if($SM.hasPerk('precise')) {
                        return World.BASE_HIT_CHANCE + 0.1;
                }
                return World.BASE_HIT_CHANCE;
        },

        getMaxWater: function() {
                if($SM.get('stores["water tank"]', true) > 0) {
                        return World.BASE_WATER + 50;
                } else if($SM.get('stores.cask', true) > 0) {
                        return World.BASE_WATER + 20;
                } else if($SM.get('stores.waterskin', true) > 0) {
                        return World.BASE_WATER + 10;
                }
                return World.BASE_WATER;
        },

        outpostUsed: function(x, y) {
                x = typeof x == 'number' ? x : World.curPos[0];
                y = typeof y == 'number' ? y : World.curPos[1];
                var used = World.usedOutposts[x + ',' + y];
                return typeof used != 'undefined' && used == true;
        },

        useOutpost: function() {
                Notifications.notify(null, _('water replenished'));
                World.setWater(World.getMaxWater());

                World.usedOutposts[World.curPos[0] + ',' + World.curPos[1]] = true;

                if (typeof World.buildMiniMap === 'function') {
                        World.drawMap();
                        World.buildMiniMap();
                        World.updateMiniMap();
                }
        },

        onArrival: function() {
                Engine.keyLock = false;


                var _saved = $SM.get('game.world') || {};
                World.state = {};
                for (var k in _saved) {
                        if (k !== 'map' && k !== 'mask' && k !== 'mapC' && k !== 'maskC' && k !== 'mapZ' && k !== 'maskZ') {
                                World.state[k] = _saved[k];
                        }
                }



                if (_saved.compressed && _saved.mapZ) {
                        World.state.map = World.decompressMapZ(_saved.mapZ, _saved.visited);
                        World.state.mask = World.decompressMaskZ(_saved.maskZ);

                        if (!World.state.map || !World.state.mask) {
                                if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) console.warn('mapZ decompress failed, falling back to mapC');
                                if (_saved.mapC) {
                                        World.state.map = World.decompressMap(_saved.mapC, _saved.visited);
                                        World.state.mask = World.decompressMask(_saved.maskC);
                                } else {
                                        World.state.map = null;
                                }
                        }
                } else if (_saved.compressed && _saved.mapC) {
                        World.state.map = World.decompressMap(_saved.mapC, _saved.visited);
                        World.state.mask = World.decompressMask(_saved.maskC);
                } else if (_saved.map) {

                        World.state.map = $.extend(true, [], _saved.map);
                        World.state.mask = $.extend(true, [], _saved.mask);
                } else {

                        var _map = World.generateMap();
                        var _mask = World.newMask();
                        World.state.map = _map;
                        World.state.mask = _mask;
                        World.state.visited = World.state.visited || {};
                }



                if (!World.state.map || !World.state.mask) {
                        if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) {
                                console.warn('World.onArrival: all map decompress paths failed, regenerating map (saved progress will be lost)');
                        }
                        World.state.map = World.generateMap();
                        World.state.mask = World.newMask();
                        World.state.visited = World.state.visited || {};

                        World._mapRegenerated = true;
                } else {
                        World._mapRegenerated = false;
                }
                if (!World.state.visited) World.state.visited = {};



                World.seedTreasuresIfNeeded();

                if (!World.state.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        World.fullScanDiscoveredLandmarks();
                }

                World.buildOutpostCache();
                World.setWater(World.getMaxWater());
                World.setHp(World.getMaxHealth());
                World.foodMove = 0;
                World.waterMove = 0;
                World.starvation = false;
                World.thirst = false;
                World.usedOutposts = {};
                World.curPos = World.copyPos(World.VILLAGE_POS);

                World.centerCameraOnPlayer(true);
                World.drawMap();
                World.drawMainMapFog();
                World.showMiniMapUI();
                World.buildMiniMap();
                World.updateMiniMap();
                World.setTitle();
                World.dead = false;
                $('div#bagspace-world > div').empty();
                World.updateSupplies();
                $('#bagspace-world').width($('#map').width());
        },

        setTitle: function() {
                document.title = _('A Barren World');
        },

        copyPos: function(pos) {
                return [pos[0], pos[1]];
        },













        compressMap: function(map) {
                var result = '';
                var size = map.length;
                var B36 = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
                for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        var row = map[i];
                        if (!row) { result += ' ' + (size).toString(36); continue; }
                        var m = row.length;
                        for (var j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                                var c = row[j];
                                var ch = (c && c.length >= 1) ? c[0] : ' ';

                                if (B36.indexOf(ch) >= 0) {

                                        throw new Error('compressMap: tile char "' + ch + '" at (' + i + ',' + j + ') is a base36 digit, RLE would corrupt');
                                }
                                var count = 1;
                                while (j + 1 < m) {
                                        var nextC = row[j + 1];
                                        var nextCh = (nextC && nextC.length >= 1) ? nextC[0] : ' ';
                                        if (nextCh === ch && count < 46655) { count++; j++; } else break;
                                }
                                if (count === 1) result += ch;
                                else result += ch + count.toString(36);
                        }
                }
                return result;
        },

        decompressMap: function(str, visited) {
                var size = World.RADIUS * 2 + 1;
                var map = new Array(size);
                for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) map[i] = new Array(size);

                for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        for (var j = 0; j < size; j++) map[i][j] = ' ';
                }

                var i = 0, j = 0, k = 0, L = str.length;
                var B36 = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
                while (k < L) {
                        var ch = str[k++];
                        var countStr = '';
                        while (k < L && B36.indexOf(str[k]) >= 0) countStr += str[k++];
                        var count = countStr ? parseInt(countStr, 36) : 1;

                        if (!isFinite(count) || count <= 0) count = 1;
                        if (count > size * size) count = size * size;
                        for (var n = 0; n < count; n++) {
                                if (j >= size) { i++; j = 0; }
                                if (i >= size) break;
                                map[i][j] = ch;
                                j++;
                        }
                        if (i >= size) break;
                }

                if (visited) {
                        for (var key in visited) {
                                var parts = key.split(',');
                                var x = +parts[0], y = +parts[1];
                                if (map[x] && map[x][y] && map[x][y].length === 1) {
                                        map[x][y] = map[x][y] + visited[key];
                                }
                        }
                }
                return map;
        },

        compressMask: function(mask) {
                var result = '';
                var size = mask.length;
                var cur = null, count = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        var row = mask[i];
                        if (!row) {
                                if (cur === 'F') count += size;
                                else { if (cur) result += cur + (count > 1 ? count.toString(36) : ''); cur = 'F'; count = size; }
                                continue;
                        }
                        var m = row.length;
                        for (var j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                                var v = row[j] ? 'T' : 'F';
                                if (v === cur && count < 46655) count++;
                                else {
                                        if (cur !== null) result += cur + (count > 1 ? count.toString(36) : '');
                                        cur = v; count = 1;
                                }
                        }
                }
                if (cur !== null) result += cur + (count > 1 ? count.toString(36) : '');
                return result;
        },

        decompressMask: function(str) {
                var size = World.RADIUS * 2 + 1;
                var mask = new Array(size);
                for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) mask[i] = new Array(size);

                for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        for (var j = 0; j < size; j++) mask[i][j] = false;
                }

                var i = 0, j = 0, k = 0, L = str.length;
                var B36 = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
                while (k < L) {
                        var ch = str[k++];
                        var countStr = '';
                        while (k < L && B36.indexOf(str[k]) >= 0) countStr += str[k++];
                        var count = countStr ? parseInt(countStr, 36) : 1;

                        if (!isFinite(count) || count <= 0) count = 1;
                        if (count > size * size) count = size * size;
                        var val = (ch === 'T');
                        for (var n = 0; n < count; n++) {
                                if (j >= size) { i++; j = 0; }
                                if (i >= size) break;
                                mask[i][j] = val;
                                j++;
                        }
                        if (i >= size) break;
                }
                return mask;
        },





        compressMapZ: function(map) {
                var rle = World.compressMap(map);
                if (typeof LZString === 'undefined') return rle;
                return LZString.compress(rle);
        },
        decompressMapZ: function(str, visited) {
                if (typeof LZString === 'undefined') return World.decompressMap(str, visited);
                var rle = LZString.decompress(str);
                if (!rle) return null;
                return World.decompressMap(rle, visited);
        },
        compressMaskZ: function(mask) {
                var rle = World.compressMask(mask);
                if (typeof LZString === 'undefined') return rle;
                return LZString.compress(rle);
        },
        decompressMaskZ: function(str) {
                if (typeof LZString === 'undefined') return World.decompressMask(str);
                var rle = LZString.decompress(str);
                if (!rle) return null;
                return World.decompressMask(rle);
        },

        centerCameraOnPlayer: function(force) {
                var mapW = (World.RADIUS * 2 + 1) * World.TILE_PX_X;
                var mapH = (World.RADIUS * 2 + 1) * World.TILE_PX_Y;
                var maxCamX = Math.max(0, mapW - World.VIEWPORT_W);
                var maxCamY = Math.max(0, mapH - World.VIEWPORT_H);
                var desiredCamX = World.curPos[0] * World.TILE_PX_X - World.VIEWPORT_W / 2;
                var desiredCamY = World.curPos[1] * World.TILE_PX_Y - World.VIEWPORT_H / 2;
                desiredCamX = Math.max(0, Math.min(desiredCamX, maxCamX));
                desiredCamY = Math.max(0, Math.min(desiredCamY, maxCamY));
                if (force) { World.camX = desiredCamX; World.camY = desiredCamY; }
        },

        updateCamera: function() {
                var mapW = (World.RADIUS * 2 + 1) * World.TILE_PX_X;
                var mapH = (World.RADIUS * 2 + 1) * World.TILE_PX_Y;
                var maxCamX = Math.max(0, mapW - World.VIEWPORT_W);
                var maxCamY = Math.max(0, mapH - World.VIEWPORT_H);
                var playerPxX = World.curPos[0] * World.TILE_PX_X;
                var playerPxY = World.curPos[1] * World.TILE_PX_Y;
                var relX = playerPxX - World.camX;
                var relY = playerPxY - World.camY;
                if (relX < World.CAMERA_MARGIN_X)                       World.camX = playerPxX - World.CAMERA_MARGIN_X;
                if (relX > World.VIEWPORT_W - World.CAMERA_MARGIN_X)    World.camX = playerPxX - (World.VIEWPORT_W - World.CAMERA_MARGIN_X);
                if (relY < World.CAMERA_MARGIN_Y)                       World.camY = playerPxY - World.CAMERA_MARGIN_Y;
                if (relY > World.VIEWPORT_H - World.CAMERA_MARGIN_Y)    World.camY = playerPxY - (World.VIEWPORT_H - World.CAMERA_MARGIN_Y);
                World.camX = Math.max(0, Math.min(World.camX, maxCamX));
                World.camY = Math.max(0, Math.min(World.camY, maxCamY));
        },

        drawMainMapFog: function() {
                var canvas = document.getElementById('mainMapFog');
                if (!canvas || !World.state) return;
                canvas.width = World.VIEWPORT_W;
                canvas.height = World.VIEWPORT_H;
                var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, World.VIEWPORT_W, World.VIEWPORT_H);
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
                var px = World.curPos[0] * World.TILE_PX_X - World.camX + World.TILE_PX_X / 2;
                var py = World.curPos[1] * World.TILE_PX_Y - World.camY + World.TILE_PX_Y / 2;

                var fogRadius = $SM.hasPerk('scout') ? 11 : World.FOG_RADIUS;
                var fogR = fogRadius * (World.TILE_PX_X + World.TILE_PX_Y) / 2;
                var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, fogR);
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, World.VIEWPORT_W, World.VIEWPORT_H);
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        },


        drawFogOnCanvas: function(canvasId, w, h, forceClear, fogRadiusTiles) {
                var canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
                if (!canvas || !World.state) return;
                canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
                var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                if (forceClear) { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); return; }
                var mapDim = World.RADIUS * 2 + 1;
                var sx = w / mapDim, sy = h / mapDim;
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
                var px = World.curPos[0] * sx;
                var py = World.curPos[1] * sy;
                var fr = fogRadiusTiles || World.FOG_RADIUS;
                var fogR = fr * Math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy);
                var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, fogR);
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        },



        scanDiscoveredLandmarks: function() {
                if (!World.state) return false;
                if (!World.state.discoveredLandmarks) World.state.discoveredLandmarks = {};
                var found = false;
                var r = World.LIGHT_RADIUS;

                r *= $SM.hasPerk('scout') ? (11 / World.LIGHT_RADIUS) : 1;
                var x = World.curPos[0], y = World.curPos[1];
                for (var i = -r; i <= r; i++) {
                        for (var j = -r + Math.abs(i); j <= r - Math.abs(i); j++) {
                                var nx = x + i, ny = y + j;
                                if (nx >= 0 && nx <= World.RADIUS * 2 && ny >= 0 && ny <= World.RADIUS * 2) {
                                        if (World.state.mask[nx] && World.state.mask[nx][ny]) {
                                                var c = World.state.map[nx][ny];
                                                var ch = (c && c.length >= 1) ? c[0] : c;
                                                if (ch && ch !== World.TILE.VILLAGE && typeof World.LANDMARKS[ch] !== 'undefined') {
                                                        var key = nx + ',' + ny;
                                                        if (!World.state.discoveredLandmarks[key]) {
                                                                World.state.discoveredLandmarks[key] = ch;
                                                                found = true;
                                                        }
                                                }
                                        }
                                }
                        }
                }
                return found;
        },

        fullScanDiscoveredLandmarks: function() {
                if (!World.state) return;
                World.state.discoveredLandmarks = {};
                var R = World.RADIUS * 2;
                for (var i = 0; i <= R; i++) {
                        for (var j = 0; j <= R; j++) {
                                if (World.state.mask[i] && World.state.mask[i][j]) {
                                        var c = World.state.map[i][j];
                                        var ch = (c && c.length >= 1) ? c[0] : c;
                                        if (ch && ch !== World.TILE.VILLAGE && typeof World.LANDMARKS[ch] !== 'undefined') {
                                                World.state.discoveredLandmarks[i + ',' + j] = ch;
                                        }
                                }
                        }
                }
        },


        buildOutpostCache: function() {
                World.outpostPositions = [];
                if (!World.state || !World.state.map) return;
                var R = World.RADIUS * 2;
                for (var i = 0; i <= R; i++) {
                        var row = World.state.map[i];
                        if (!row) continue;
                        for (var j = 0; j <= R; j++) {
                                var c = row[j];
                                if (!c) continue;
                                var ch = (c.length > 1) ? c[0] : c;
                                if (ch === World.TILE.OUTPOST) {
                                        World.outpostPositions.push([i, j]);
                                }
                        }
                }
        },

        addOutpostToCache: function(x, y) {
                if (!World.outpostPositions) {
                        World.outpostPositions = [];
                }
                for (var k = 0; k < World.outpostPositions.length; k++) {
                        if (World.outpostPositions[k][0] === x && World.outpostPositions[k][1] === y) {
                                return;
                        }
                }
                World.outpostPositions.push([x, y]);
        },

        showMiniMapUI: function() {
                if ($('#miniMap').length === 0) {
                        var mm = document.createElement('div');
                        mm.id = 'miniMap';
                        var fog = document.createElement('canvas');
                        fog.className = 'mm-fog'; fog.id = 'mmFog';
                        mm.appendChild(fog);
                        document.body.appendChild(mm);

                        $('#miniMap').off('click').on('click', function(e) {
                                var now = Date.now();
                                if (now - World.mmLastClickTime < 350) {
                                        World.mmExpandedVisible = true;
                                        $('#miniMapExpanded').css('display', 'flex');
                                        World.buildExpandedMiniMap();
                                        World.updateExpandedMiniMap();
                                }
                                World.mmLastClickTime = now;
                        });
                }
                if ($('#miniMapExpanded').length === 0) {
                        var mme = document.createElement('div');
                        mme.id = 'miniMapExpanded';
                        var btn = document.createElement('button');
                        btn.className = 'mm-close-btn'; btn.id = 'mmCloseBtn'; btn.innerHTML = '&#x2715;';
                        var inner = document.createElement('div');
                        inner.className = 'mm-inner'; inner.id = 'mmExpandedInner';
                        var fog2 = document.createElement('canvas');
                        fog2.className = 'mm-fog'; fog2.id = 'mmExpandedFog';
                        inner.appendChild(fog2);
                        mme.appendChild(btn);
                        mme.appendChild(inner);
                        document.body.appendChild(mme);

                        $('#mmCloseBtn').off('click').on('click', function(e) {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                World.mmExpandedVisible = false;
                                World.cheatActive = false;
                                World.cheatState = { step: 0, count: 0 };
                                $('#miniMapExpanded').css('display', 'none');
                        });

                        $('#mmExpandedInner').off('click').on('click', function(e) {
                                if (World.cheatActive) return;
                                var rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
                                var x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                                var y = e.clientY - rect.top;
                                var w = rect.width, h = rect.height;
                                var quadrant;
                                if (x < w/2 && y < h/2)       quadrant = 0;
                                else if (x >= w/2 && y < h/2)  quadrant = 1;
                                else if (x < w/2 && y >= h/2)  quadrant = 2;
                                else                           quadrant = 3;
                                if (quadrant === World.cheatState.step) {
                                        World.cheatState.count++;
                                        if (World.cheatState.count >= World.CHEAT_TARGET) {
                                                World.cheatState.step++;
                                                World.cheatState.count = 0;
                                                if (World.cheatState.step >= 4) {
                                                        World.cheatActive = true;
                                                        World.buildExpandedMiniMap();
                                                        World.updateExpandedMiniMap();
                                                }
                                        }
                                } else {
                                        World.cheatState.step = 0;
                                        World.cheatState.count = (quadrant === 0) ? 1 : 0;
                                }
                        });
                }
                $('#miniMap').css('display', 'block');
        },

        hideMiniMapUI: function() {

                $('#miniMap').remove();
                $('#miniMapExpanded').remove();
                World.mmExpandedVisible = false;
                World.cheatActive = false;
                World.cheatState = { step: 0, count: 0 };
        },




        buildMiniMap: function() {
                var $mm = $('#miniMap');
                if (!$mm.length || !World.state) return;
                var mmEl = $mm[0];


                var oldChildren = mmEl.querySelectorAll('.mm-land, .mm-outpost, .mm-player, .mm-home');
                for (var i = 0; i < oldChildren.length; i++) {
                        if (oldChildren[i].parentNode === mmEl) mmEl.removeChild(oldChildren[i]);
                }

                var mapDim = World.RADIUS * 2 + 1;
                var sx = World.MINIMAP_W / mapDim;
                var sy = World.MINIMAP_H / mapDim;

                var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

                var dl = World.state.discoveredLandmarks || {};

                var visited = World.state.visited || {};
                for (var key in dl) {
                        var parts = key.split(',');
                        var i = +parts[0], j = +parts[1];
                        var ch = dl[key];

                        if (ch === World.TILE.OUTPOST) continue;
                        var sp = document.createElement('span');

                        if (visited[key]) {
                                sp.className = 'mm-outpost';
                                sp.textContent = World.TILE.OUTPOST;
                        } else {

                                sp.className = 'mm-land' + (World.isLandmarkDepleted(ch) ? ' mm-depleted' : '');
                                sp.textContent = ch;
                        }
                        sp.style.left = (i * sx) + 'px';
                        sp.style.top  = (j * sy) + 'px';
                        frag.appendChild(sp);
                }


                var op = World.outpostPositions || [];
                for (var k = 0; k < op.length; k++) {
                        var i = op[k][0], j = op[k][1];
                        var sp = document.createElement('span');
                        sp.className = 'mm-outpost';
                        sp.textContent = World.TILE.OUTPOST;
                        sp.style.left = (i * sx) + 'px';
                        sp.style.top  = (j * sy) + 'px';
                        frag.appendChild(sp);
                }

                var home = document.createElement('span');
                home.className = 'mm-home';
                home.textContent = World.TILE.VILLAGE;
                home.style.left = (World.VILLAGE_POS[0] * sx) + 'px';
                home.style.top  = (World.VILLAGE_POS[1] * sy) + 'px';
                frag.appendChild(home);

                var dot = document.createElement('div');
                dot.className = 'mm-player';
                dot.id = 'mmPlayer';
                frag.appendChild(dot);

                mmEl.appendChild(frag);

                World.drawFogOnCanvas('mmFog', World.MINIMAP_W, World.MINIMAP_H, false, World.MINIMAP_FOG_RADIUS);
        },

        updateMiniMap: function() {
                var $dot = $('#mmPlayer');
                if (!$dot.length || !World.state) return;
                var mapDim = World.RADIUS * 2 + 1;
                var sx = World.MINIMAP_W / mapDim;
                var sy = World.MINIMAP_H / mapDim;
                $dot.css({ left: (World.curPos[0] * sx) + 'px', top: (World.curPos[1] * sy) + 'px' });
                World.drawFogOnCanvas('mmFog', World.MINIMAP_W, World.MINIMAP_H, false, World.MINIMAP_FOG_RADIUS);
                if (World.mmExpandedVisible) World.updateExpandedMiniMap();
        },

        calcExpandedSize: function() {
                var maxW = window.innerWidth * 0.90;
                var maxH = window.innerHeight * 0.85;
                if (maxW / maxH > 4/3) {
                        World.mmExpandedH = Math.floor(maxH);
                        World.mmExpandedW = Math.floor(World.mmExpandedH * 4/3);
                } else {
                        World.mmExpandedW = Math.floor(maxW);
                        World.mmExpandedH = Math.floor(World.mmExpandedW * 3/4);
                }
        },

        buildExpandedMiniMap: function() {
                var $inner = $('#mmExpandedInner');
                if (!$inner.length || !World.state) return;
                var innerEl = $inner[0];

                var oldChildren = innerEl.querySelectorAll('.mm-land, .mm-outpost, .mm-player, .mm-home');
                for (var i = 0; i < oldChildren.length; i++) {
                        if (oldChildren[i].parentNode === innerEl) innerEl.removeChild(oldChildren[i]);
                }

                World.calcExpandedSize();
                $inner.css({ width: World.mmExpandedW + 'px', height: World.mmExpandedH + 'px' });

                var mapDim = World.RADIUS * 2 + 1;
                var sx = World.mmExpandedW / mapDim;
                var sy = World.mmExpandedH / mapDim;

                var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
                var visited = World.state.visited || {};
                if (World.cheatActive) {

                        var R = World.RADIUS * 2;
                        for (var i = 0; i <= R; i++) {
                                for (var j = 0; j <= R; j++) {
                                        var c = World.state.map[i][j];
                                        if (!c) continue;
                                        if (c === World.TILE.VILLAGE) continue;
                                        var ch = (c.length > 1) ? c[0] : c;
                                        if (typeof World.LANDMARKS[ch] !== 'undefined') {

                                                var vkey = i + ',' + j;
                                                var sp = document.createElement('span');
                                                if (ch === World.TILE.OUTPOST || visited[vkey]) {
                                                        sp.className = 'mm-outpost';
                                                        sp.textContent = World.TILE.OUTPOST;
                                                } else {

                                                        sp.className = 'mm-land' + (World.isLandmarkDepleted(ch) ? ' mm-depleted' : '');
                                                        sp.textContent = ch;
                                                }
                                                sp.style.left = (i * sx) + 'px';
                                                sp.style.top  = (j * sy) + 'px';
                                                frag.appendChild(sp);
                                        }
                                }
                        }
                } else {

                        var dl = World.state.discoveredLandmarks || {};
