    _initializing: true,

    init: function() {

        try {
            if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.get) {
                var savedAchs = $SM.get('previous.achievements');
                if (savedAchs && typeof savedAchs === 'object') {
                    for (var id in savedAchs) {
                        if (savedAchs.hasOwnProperty(id) && savedAchs[id]) {
                            Achievements._unlocked[id] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('Achievements.init pre-load error:', e);
            }
        }

        if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && $.Dispatch) {
            $.Dispatch('stateUpdate').subscribe(Achievements.handleStateUpdates);
        }

        setTimeout(function() { Achievements._initializing = false; }, 2000);
    },

    isUnlocked: function(id) {
        if (Achievements._unlocked[id]) return true;
        try {
            if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.get) {
                var achState = $SM.get('previous.achievements');
                if (achState && achState[id]) {
                    Achievements._unlocked[id] = true;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        return false;
    },

    unlock: function(id) {
        try {
            if (Achievements.isUnlocked(id)) return;
            var def = Achievements.TABLE[id];
            if (!def) return;

            Achievements._unlocked[id] = true;
            if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.set) {
                var achs = $SM.get('previous.achievements') || {};
                achs[id] = true;
                $SM.set('previous.achievements', achs);

                if (def.rewards) {
                    for (var k in def.rewards) {
                        $SM.add('stores["'+k+'"]', def.rewards[k]);
                    }
                }
            }

            Achievements._queue.push(def);
            Achievements._pump();
        } catch(e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('Achievements.unlock('+id+') error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    _pump: function() {
        if (Achievements._showing) return;
        if (Achievements._queue.length === 0) return;
        var def = Achievements._queue.shift();
        Achievements._showing = true;
        if (typeof window.pixelToast === 'function') {
            window.pixelToast({
                title: def.title,
                subtitle: def.subtitle || '',
                confetti: (typeof def.confetti === 'number') ? def.confetti : 50,
                duration: 4000
            });
        }

        setTimeout(function() {
            Achievements._showing = false;
            Achievements._pump();
        }, 4000 + 1000);
    },

    checkBuild: function(thing, type) {
        try {
            if (type === 'building') {
                var buildId = Achievements.BUILD_MAP[thing];
                if (!buildId) return;
                if (Achievements.isUnlocked(buildId)) return;

                if (thing === 'trap') {
                    if ($SM.get('game.buildings["trap"]') !== 1) return;
                }
                if (thing === 'hut') {
                    if ($SM.get('game.buildings["hut"]') !== 1) return;
                }
                Achievements.unlock(buildId);
            } else {

                var craftId = Achievements.CRAFT_MAP[thing];
                if (!craftId) return;
                if (Achievements.isUnlocked(craftId)) return;

                var count = $SM.get('stores["'+thing+'"]', true);
                if (count !== 1) return;
                Achievements.unlock(craftId);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('Achievements.checkBuild error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    checkWorker: function(job) {
        try {
            var id = Achievements.JOB_MAP[job];
            if (id && !Achievements.isUnlocked(id)) Achievements.unlock(id);
        } catch(e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('Achievements.checkWorker error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    checkPerk: function(name) {
        try {
            var id = Achievements.PERK_MAP[name];
            if (id && !Achievements.isUnlocked(id)) Achievements.unlock(id);

            var perks = (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.get) ? $SM.get('character.perks') : null;
            if (perks) {
                var count = 0;
                for (var k in perks) {
                    if (perks.hasOwnProperty(k)) count++;
                }
                if (count >= 11) {
                    Achievements.unlock('skill_all');
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('Achievements.checkPerk error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    handleStateUpdates: function(e) {
        try {
            if (!e) return;

            if (Achievements._initializing) return;

            if (e.stateName && e.stateName.indexOf('game.population') === 0) {
                if ((typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.get) && (($SM.get('game.population', true) || 0) >= 80)) {
                    Achievements.unlock('population_80');
                }
            }

            if (e.category === 'stores' || (e.stateName && e.stateName.indexOf('stores') === 0)) {
                if ((typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.get) && (($SM.get('stores.wood', true) || 0) >= 10000)) {
                    Achievements.unlock('wood_10000');
                }
            }

            if (e.stateName && e.stateName.indexOf('game.cityCleared') === 0) {
                if ((typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.get) && $SM.get('game.cityCleared') === true) {
                    Achievements.unlock('city_cleared');
                }
            }
        } catch(err) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('Achievements.handleStateUpdates error:', err);
            }
        }
    }
};

if (typeof $ !== 'undefined') {
    $(function(){
        if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined') {
            Achievements.init();
        }
    });
}
</script>

<script data-source="script/power_station.js">

var PowerStation = {

    CHECK_INTERVAL: 3 * 60 * 1000,
    TRIGGER_CHANCE: 0.5,

    OFFSET: null,

    UNLOCK_DELAY: 3 * 60 * 1000,



    GENERATOR_TIMEOUT: 10 * 60 * 1000,

    BASIC_BUILDINGS: [
        'trap', 'cart', 'hut', 'lodge', 'trading post', 'tannery',
        'smokehouse', 'workshop', 'steelworks', 'armoury',

        'furnace'
    ],

    RESOURCE_REQ: {
        'wood': 1000,
        'fur': 600,
        'meat': 600,
        'iron': 1000,
        'coal': 500,
        'steel': 500,
        'sulphur': 200
    },

    _timer: null,
    _genTimeoutTimer: null,

    init: function() {
        if (PowerStation._timer) return;
        PowerStation._timer = setInterval(PowerStation.tick, PowerStation.CHECK_INTERVAL);

        if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)
            && !$SM.get('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', true)) {
            PowerStation.schedulePowerPlantUnlock();
        }

        if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.blackoutDone', true)
            && !$SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)) {
            PowerStation.scheduleGeneratorTimeout();
        }
    },

    ePos: function() {
        var saved = $SM.get('game.powerStation.pos', true);
        if (saved && Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length === 2) return saved;

        return [World.VILLAGE_POS[0], World.VILLAGE_POS[1]];
    },

    conditionsMet: function() {
        try {
            if (typeof Engine === 'undefined' || typeof Room === 'undefined') return false;

            if (Engine.activeModule !== Room) return false;

            if (typeof Events !== 'undefined' && Events.activeEvent()) return false;

            if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.blackoutDone', true)) return false;

            if ($SM.get('stores.compass', true) <= 0) return false;

            for (var i = 0; i < PowerStation.BASIC_BUILDINGS.length; i++) {
                var b = PowerStation.BASIC_BUILDINGS[i];
                if ($SM.get('game.buildings["' + b + '"]', true) < 1) return false;
            }

            for (var k in PowerStation.RESOURCE_REQ) {
                if ($SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]', true) < PowerStation.RESOURCE_REQ[k]) return false;
            }
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    },

    tick: function() {
        try {
            if (!PowerStation.conditionsMet()) return;
            if (Math.random() > PowerStation.TRIGGER_CHANCE) return;
            if (Events.activeEvent()) return;



            PowerStation.completeBlackout();
            Events.startEvent(Events.BlackoutEvent);
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.tick error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    completeBlackout: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.blackoutDone', true)) return;
            $SM.set('game.powerStation.blackoutDone', true);

            $SM.set('game.powerStation.blackoutDoneAt', Date.now());
            PowerStation.placeOnMap();
            Notifications.notify(null, _('建造者告诉你远处有一个废弃发电站, 可以到那里看看.'));

            PowerStation.scheduleGeneratorTimeout();

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) Engine.saveGameNow();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.completeBlackout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    placeOnMap: function() {
        try {
            var changed = false;



            var saved = $SM.get('game.world') || {};
            var map = null, mask = null;
            if (saved.compressed && saved.mapZ) {
                map = World.decompressMapZ(saved.mapZ, saved.visited);
                mask = World.decompressMaskZ(saved.maskZ);
                if (!map || !mask) { map = null; mask = null; }
            }
            if (!map && saved.compressed && saved.mapC) {
                map = World.decompressMap(saved.mapC, saved.visited);
                mask = World.decompressMask(saved.maskC);
            }
            var placedPos = null;
            if (map && mask) {

                var existingE = World._findTileInMap(map, World.TILE.POWER_STATION);
                placedPos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', World.TILE.POWER_STATION, map, existingE ? [existingE] : null);
                var x = placedPos[0], y = placedPos[1];
                if (map[x] && map[x][y]) {

                    World.uncoverMap(x, y, 0, mask);

                    saved.mapZ = World.compressMapZ(map);
                    saved.maskZ = World.compressMaskZ(mask);
                    delete saved.mapC;
                    delete saved.maskC;

                    delete saved.map;
                    delete saved.mask;
                    saved.visited = saved.visited || {};
                    if (!saved.discoveredLandmarks) saved.discoveredLandmarks = {};

                    for (var k in saved.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        if (saved.discoveredLandmarks[k] === World.TILE.POWER_STATION) delete saved.discoveredLandmarks[k];
                    }
                    saved.discoveredLandmarks[x + ',' + y] = World.TILE.POWER_STATION;

                    $SM.set('game.powerStation.pos', [x, y]);

                    $SM.setM('game.world', saved);
                    changed = true;
                }
            } else if (saved.map) {

                var existingE2 = World._findTileInMap(saved.map, World.TILE.POWER_STATION);
                placedPos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', World.TILE.POWER_STATION, saved.map, existingE2 ? [existingE2] : null);
                var x2 = placedPos[0], y2 = placedPos[1];
                if (saved.map[x2] && saved.map[x2][y2]) {
                    if (saved.mask) saved.mask[x2][y2] = true;

                    var _upgMap = saved.map;
                    var _upgMask = saved.mask || World.newMask();
                    saved.mapZ = World.compressMapZ(_upgMap);
                    saved.maskZ = World.compressMaskZ(_upgMask);
                    delete saved.map;
                    delete saved.mask;
                    saved.compressed = true;
                    for (var k2 in saved.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        if (saved.discoveredLandmarks[k2] === World.TILE.POWER_STATION) delete saved.discoveredLandmarks[k2];
                    }
                    if (!saved.discoveredLandmarks) saved.discoveredLandmarks = {};
                    saved.discoveredLandmarks[x2 + ',' + y2] = World.TILE.POWER_STATION;
                    $SM.set('game.powerStation.pos', [x2, y2]);
                    $SM.setM('game.world', saved);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            if (World.state && World.state.map) {
                var existingE3 = World._findTileInMap(World.state.map, World.TILE.POWER_STATION);
                var livePos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', World.TILE.POWER_STATION, World.state.map, existingE3 ? [existingE3] : null);
                var lx = livePos[0], ly = livePos[1];
                if (World.state.map[lx] && World.state.map[lx][ly]) {

                    World.uncoverMap(lx, ly, 0, World.state.mask);
                    if (!World.state.discoveredLandmarks) World.state.discoveredLandmarks = {};
                    for (var k3 in World.state.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        if (World.state.discoveredLandmarks[k3] === World.TILE.POWER_STATION) delete World.state.discoveredLandmarks[k3];
                    }
                    World.state.discoveredLandmarks[lx + ',' + ly] = World.TILE.POWER_STATION;
                    $SM.set('game.powerStation.pos', [lx, ly]);
                    World.drawMap();
                    if (typeof World.buildMiniMap === 'function') World.buildMiniMap();
                }
            }
            return changed;
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.placeOnMap error:', e);
            }
            return false;
        }
    },

    claimGenerator: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)) return;
            $SM.set('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true);

            $SM.set('game.powerStation.generatorObtainedAt', Date.now());

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) Engine.saveGameNow();

            if (PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer) {
                clearTimeout(PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer);
                PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer = null;
            }

            $SM.add('stores["diesel"]', 100);

            PowerStation.unlockWithDiesel('power_generator_found');

            PowerStation.unlockWithDiesel('power_diesel_trade');


            PowerStation.schedulePowerPlantUnlock();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.claimGenerator error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    schedulePowerPlantUnlock: function() {
        try {

            if ($SM.get('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', true)) return;
            var claimedAt = $SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtainedAt', true) || Date.now();
            var elapsed = Date.now() - claimedAt;
            var delay = PowerStation.UNLOCK_DELAY - elapsed;
            if (delay <= 0) {

                PowerStation.unlockPowerPlant();
            } else {
                setTimeout(PowerStation.unlockPowerPlant, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.schedulePowerPlantUnlock error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    unlockPowerPlant: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', true)) return;
            $SM.set('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', 1);
            Notifications.notify(null, _('建造者说, 村里有了柴油发电机, 也许能建一座真正的发电厂.'));
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.unlockPowerPlant error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    onGoHome: function() {
        try {
            if (!$SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)) return;
            if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.safeReturnDone', true)) return;
            $SM.set('game.powerStation.safeReturnDone', true);

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) Engine.saveGameNow();

            PowerStation.unlockWithDiesel('power_safe_return',
                '，外星合金 +1，钢 +100',
                { 'alien alloy': 1, 'steel': 100 });
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.onGoHome error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    scheduleGeneratorTimeout: function() {
        try {

            if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)) return;
            var doneAt = $SM.get('game.powerStation.blackoutDoneAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = PowerStation.GENERATOR_TIMEOUT - (Date.now() - doneAt);
            if (PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer) {
                clearTimeout(PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer);
                PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer = null;
            }
            if (delay <= 0) {

                PowerStation.onGeneratorTimeout();
            } else {
                PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer = setTimeout(
                    PowerStation.onGeneratorTimeout, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.scheduleGeneratorTimeout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    onGeneratorTimeout: function() {
        try {
            PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer = null;

            if ($SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)) return;

            if (typeof PowerSystem !== 'undefined' && PowerSystem.punish) {
                PowerSystem.punish('no_generator');
            }

            if (!$SM.get('game.powerStation.generatorObtained', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.powerStation.blackoutDoneAt', Date.now());
                PowerStation._genTimeoutTimer = setTimeout(
                    PowerStation.onGeneratorTimeout, PowerStation.GENERATOR_TIMEOUT);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.onGeneratorTimeout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    unlockWithDiesel: function(id, extraSubtitle, extraRewards) {
        try {
            if (typeof Achievements === 'undefined' || !Achievements.TABLE[id]) return;
            var n = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);
            var rewards = { 'diesel': n };
            if (extraRewards) {
                for (var k in extraRewards) {
                    rewards[k] = extraRewards[k];
                }
            }
            Achievements.TABLE[id].rewards = rewards;
            Achievements.TABLE[id].subtitle = '柴油 +' + n + (extraSubtitle || '');
            Achievements.unlock(id);
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerStation.unlockWithDiesel error:', e);
            }
        }
    }
};

<script data-source="script/water_station.js">

var WaterStation = {

    CHECK_INTERVAL: 3 * 60 * 1000,
    TRIGGER_CHANCE: 0.3,

    OFFSET: null,

    PUMP_TIMEOUT: 10 * 60 * 1000,

    PUMP_READY_DELAY: 10 * 60 * 1000,

    BASIC_BUILDINGS: [
        'trap', 'cart', 'hut', 'lodge', 'trading post', 'tannery',
        'smokehouse', 'workshop', 'steelworks', 'armoury',

        'furnace',

        'power plant'
    ],

    _timer: null,
    _pumpTimeoutTimer: null,
    _pumpReadyTimer: null,

    init: function() {
        if (WaterStation._timer) return;
        WaterStation._timer = setInterval(WaterStation.tick, WaterStation.CHECK_INTERVAL);

        if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.droughtDone', true)
            && !$SM.get('game.waterStation.visited', true)) {
            WaterStation.schedulePumpTimeout();
        }


        if (!WaterStation.pumpReady()
            && (WaterStation.pumpHome() || $SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpObtained', true))) {
            if (!WaterStation.pumpHome()) {
                WaterStation.onGoHome();
            } else {
                WaterStation.schedulePumpReady();
            }
        }
    },

    qPos: function() {
        var saved = $SM.get('game.waterStation.pos', true);
        if (saved && Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length === 2) return saved;

        return [World.VILLAGE_POS[0], World.VILLAGE_POS[1]];
    },

    conditionsMet: function() {
        try {
            if (typeof Engine === 'undefined' || typeof Room === 'undefined') return false;

            if (Engine.activeModule !== Room) return false;

            if (typeof Events !== 'undefined' && Events.activeEvent()) return false;

            if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.droughtDone', true)) return false;

            if ($SM.get('stores.compass', true) <= 0) return false;

            if (typeof Outside === 'undefined' || typeof Outside.getMaxPopulation !== 'function') return false;
            var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true) || 0;
            if (pop < Outside.getMaxPopulation()) return false;

            for (var i = 0; i < WaterStation.BASIC_BUILDINGS.length; i++) {
                var b = WaterStation.BASIC_BUILDINGS[i];
                if ($SM.get('game.buildings["' + b + '"]', true) < 1) return false;
            }

            if (typeof PowerSystem !== 'undefined' && PowerSystem.boxUnlocked) {
                if (!PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return false;
            }
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    },

    tick: function() {
        try {
            if (!WaterStation.conditionsMet()) return;
            if (Math.random() > WaterStation.TRIGGER_CHANCE) return;
            if (Events.activeEvent()) return;

            WaterStation.completeDrought();
            Events.startEvent(Events.WaterCrisisEvent);
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.tick error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    completeDrought: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.droughtDone', true)) return;
            $SM.set('game.waterStation.droughtDone', true);

            $SM.set('game.waterStation.droughtDoneAt', Date.now());
            WaterStation.placeOnMap();
            Notifications.notify(null, _('the builder says there\'s an abandoned water plant south of the village, maybe with a usable pump'));

            WaterStation.schedulePumpTimeout();

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) Engine.saveGameNow();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.completeDrought error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    placeOnMap: function() {
        try {
            var changed = false;


            var saved = $SM.get('game.world') || {};
            var map = null, mask = null;
            if (saved.compressed && saved.mapZ) {
                map = World.decompressMapZ(saved.mapZ, saved.visited);
                mask = World.decompressMaskZ(saved.maskZ);
                if (!map || !mask) { map = null; mask = null; }
            }
            if (!map && saved.compressed && saved.mapC) {
                map = World.decompressMap(saved.mapC, saved.visited);
                mask = World.decompressMask(saved.maskC);
            }

            var avoidList = [];
            var ePosInMap = World._findTileInMap(map || saved.map, World.TILE.POWER_STATION);
            if (ePosInMap) avoidList.push(ePosInMap);
            var ePosSaved = $SM.get('game.powerStation.pos', true);
            if (ePosSaved && (!ePosInMap || ePosInMap[0] !== ePosSaved[0] || ePosInMap[1] !== ePosSaved[1])) {
                avoidList.push(ePosSaved);
            }
            var qPosInMap = World._findTileInMap(map || saved.map, World.TILE.WATER_PLANT);
            if (qPosInMap) avoidList.push(qPosInMap);

            var placedPos = null;
            if (map && mask) {
                placedPos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', World.TILE.WATER_PLANT, map, avoidList.length > 0 ? avoidList : null);
                var x = placedPos[0], y = placedPos[1];
                if (map[x] && map[x][y]) {

                    World.uncoverMap(x, y, 0, mask);

                    saved.mapZ = World.compressMapZ(map);
                    saved.maskZ = World.compressMaskZ(mask);
                    delete saved.mapC;
                    delete saved.maskC;

                    delete saved.map;
                    delete saved.mask;
                    saved.visited = saved.visited || {};
                    if (!saved.discoveredLandmarks) saved.discoveredLandmarks = {};

                    for (var k in saved.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        if (saved.discoveredLandmarks[k] === World.TILE.WATER_PLANT) delete saved.discoveredLandmarks[k];
                    }
                    saved.discoveredLandmarks[x + ',' + y] = World.TILE.WATER_PLANT;
                    $SM.set('game.waterStation.pos', [x, y]);
                    $SM.setM('game.world', saved);
                    changed = true;
                }
            } else if (saved.map) {

                placedPos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', World.TILE.WATER_PLANT, saved.map, avoidList.length > 0 ? avoidList : null);
                var x2 = placedPos[0], y2 = placedPos[1];
                if (saved.map[x2] && saved.map[x2][y2]) {
                    if (saved.mask) saved.mask[x2][y2] = true;

                    var _upgMap = saved.map;
                    var _upgMask = saved.mask || World.newMask();
                    saved.mapZ = World.compressMapZ(_upgMap);
                    saved.maskZ = World.compressMaskZ(_upgMask);
                    delete saved.map;
                    delete saved.mask;
                    saved.compressed = true;
                    for (var k2 in saved.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        if (saved.discoveredLandmarks[k2] === World.TILE.WATER_PLANT) delete saved.discoveredLandmarks[k2];
                    }
                    if (!saved.discoveredLandmarks) saved.discoveredLandmarks = {};
                    saved.discoveredLandmarks[x2 + ',' + y2] = World.TILE.WATER_PLANT;
                    $SM.set('game.waterStation.pos', [x2, y2]);
                    $SM.setM('game.world', saved);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            if (World.state && World.state.map) {
                var liveAvoid = [];
                var eLive = World._findTileInMap(World.state.map, World.TILE.POWER_STATION);
                if (eLive) liveAvoid.push(eLive);
                var qLive = World._findTileInMap(World.state.map, World.TILE.WATER_PLANT);
                if (qLive) liveAvoid.push(qLive);
                var livePos = World.placeLandmarkByLayer('L2', World.TILE.WATER_PLANT, World.state.map, liveAvoid.length > 0 ? liveAvoid : null);
                var lx = livePos[0], ly = livePos[1];
                if (World.state.map[lx] && World.state.map[lx][ly]) {

                    World.uncoverMap(lx, ly, 0, World.state.mask);
                    if (!World.state.discoveredLandmarks) World.state.discoveredLandmarks = {};
                    for (var k3 in World.state.discoveredLandmarks) {
                        if (World.state.discoveredLandmarks[k3] === World.TILE.WATER_PLANT) delete World.state.discoveredLandmarks[k3];
                    }
                    World.state.discoveredLandmarks[lx + ',' + ly] = World.TILE.WATER_PLANT;
                    $SM.set('game.waterStation.pos', [lx, ly]);
                    World.drawMap();
                    if (typeof World.buildMiniMap === 'function') World.buildMiniMap();
                }
            }
            return changed;
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.placeOnMap error:', e);
            }
            return false;
        }
    },

    onVisit: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer) {
                clearTimeout(WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer);
                WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer = null;
            }
            if (!$SM.get('game.waterStation.visited', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.waterStation.visited', true);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.onVisit error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    claimPump: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpObtained', true)) return;
            $SM.set('game.waterStation.pumpObtained', true);
            $SM.set('game.waterStation.pumpObtainedAt', Date.now());

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) Engine.saveGameNow();

            WaterStation.onVisit();

            if (!$SM.get('game.buildings["water pump"]', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.buildings["water pump"]', 1);
            }

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                Engine.saveGameNow();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.claimPump error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    pumpHome: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpHome', true) > 0;
    },
    pumpReady: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpReady', true) > 0;
    },


    onGoHome: function() {
        try {
            if (!$SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpObtained', true)) return;
            if (WaterStation.pumpHome()) return;
            $SM.set('game.waterStation.pumpHome', true);
            $SM.set('game.waterStation.pumpHomeAt', Date.now());
            WaterStation.schedulePumpReady();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.onGoHome error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    schedulePumpReady: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterStation.pumpReady()) return;
            if (!WaterStation.pumpHome()) return;
            var homeAt = $SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpHomeAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = WaterStation.PUMP_READY_DELAY - (Date.now() - homeAt);
            if (WaterStation._pumpReadyTimer) {
                clearTimeout(WaterStation._pumpReadyTimer);
                WaterStation._pumpReadyTimer = null;
            }
            if (delay <= 0) {
                WaterStation.unlockPumpReady();
            } else {
                WaterStation._pumpReadyTimer = setTimeout(
                    WaterStation.unlockPumpReady, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.schedulePumpReady error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    unlockPumpReady: function() {
        try {
            WaterStation._pumpReadyTimer = null;
            if (WaterStation.pumpReady()) return;
            $SM.set('game.waterStation.pumpReady', true);
            Notifications.notify(null, _('the builder says now that there\'s a pump, everyone can draw water'));

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.updateBuildButtons) {
                Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                Engine.saveGameNow();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.unlockPumpReady error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    schedulePumpTimeout: function() {
        try {

            if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.visited', true)) return;
            if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.pumpObtained', true)) return;
            var doneAt = $SM.get('game.waterStation.droughtDoneAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = WaterStation.PUMP_TIMEOUT - (Date.now() - doneAt);
            if (WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer) {
                clearTimeout(WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer);
                WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer = null;
            }
            if (delay <= 0) {

                WaterStation.onPumpTimeout();
            } else {
                WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer = setTimeout(
                    WaterStation.onPumpTimeout, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.schedulePumpTimeout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    onPumpTimeout: function() {
        try {
            WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer = null;

            if ($SM.get('game.waterStation.visited', true)) return;

            WaterStation.punish();

            if (!$SM.get('game.waterStation.visited', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.waterStation.droughtDoneAt', Date.now());
                WaterStation._pumpTimeoutTimer = setTimeout(
                    WaterStation.onPumpTimeout, WaterStation.PUMP_TIMEOUT);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.onPumpTimeout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    punish: function() {
        try {

            var cap = 15 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
            var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true) || 0;
            if (pop > cap) {
                $SM.set('game.population', cap);
            }

            var total = 80 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 41);
            var stolen = WaterStation.stealSupplies(total);

            Notifications.notify(Room, _('the villagers can no longer endure the thirst, and leave the village by night. those who left carried off {0} supplies', stolen));

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                Engine.saveGameNow();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.punish error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    stealSupplies: function(total) {
        try {
            var pool = [];
            var stores = $SM.get('stores') || {};
            for (var k in stores) {
                if (k == 'compass') continue;
                if (k == 'animal organs' || k == 'animal brains') continue;
                var v = $SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]');
                if (typeof v == 'number' && v >= 1) pool.push(k);
            }
            var taken = 0;
            while (total > 0 && pool.length > 0) {
                var idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
                var k = pool[idx];
                var have = Math.floor($SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]'));
                var take = Math.min(have, total, 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 30));
                if (take > 0) {
                    $SM.add('stores["' + k + '"]', -take, true);
                    taken += take;
                    total -= take;
                }
                pool.splice(idx, 1);
            }
            if (taken > 0) {
                $SM.fireUpdate('stores', true);
            }
            return taken;
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterStation.stealSupplies error:', e);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
};

<script data-source="script/power_system.js">

var PowerSystem = {

    TICK: 10 * 1000,
    BOX_DELAY: 3 * 60 * 1000,
    BATCH2_DELAY: 30 * 60 * 1000,



    BLACKOUT_GRACE: 30 * 60 * 1000,

    BASE_CAPACITY: 500,


    GEN: {
        'diesel generator': 8,
        'wind turbine': 3,
        'solar panel': 2,
        'hydro generator': 4,
        'geothermal generator': 4
    },

    STORE_CAP: {
        'battery bank': 100
    },

    USE: {
        'hut': 0.5,
        'lodge': 2,
        'trading post': 1,
        'tannery': 3,
        'smokehouse': 6,
        'workshop': 10,
        'steelworks': 11,
        'armoury': 15,

        'furnace': 8,
        'power plant': 5
    },

    BASE_LIGHT: 1,

    CRAFTABLES: [
        'wind turbine', 'hydro generator', 'geothermal generator',
        'solar panel', 'battery bank'
    ],

    BATCH2: ['solar panel', 'battery bank'],

    _boxTimer: null,
    _b2Timer: null,
    _tickTimer: null,
    _blackoutTimer: null,

    init: function() {
        try {

            if ($SM.get('game.buildings["supercapacitor"]', true)) {
                $SM.remove('game.buildings["supercapacitor"]');
            }

            if (PowerSystem.plantBuilt() && !PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) {
                if (!$SM.get('game.powerSystem.plantBuiltAt', true)) {
                    $SM.set('game.powerSystem.plantBuiltAt', Date.now());
                }
                PowerSystem.scheduleBox();
            }

            if (PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) {
                if (!PowerSystem.batch2Unlocked()) {
                    PowerSystem.scheduleBatch2();
                }
                PowerSystem.startTick();
                PowerSystem.updateBox();

                var stored = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.stored', true);
                if (typeof stored == 'number' && stored <= 0 && !PowerSystem._blackoutTimer) {
                    PowerSystem.scheduleBlackoutCheck();
                }
            }
            PowerSystem.syncDieselIncome();
            $.Dispatch('stateUpdate').subscribe(PowerSystem.handleStateUpdates);
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.init error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    plantBuilt: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.buildings["power plant"]', true) > 0;
    },
    boxUnlocked: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.powerSystem.boxUnlocked', true) > 0;
    },
    batch2Unlocked: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.powerSystem.batch2Unlocked', true) > 0;
    },

    craftGate: function(thing) {
        if (!PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return false;
        if (PowerSystem.BATCH2.indexOf(thing) >= 0 && !PowerSystem.batch2Unlocked()) return false;
        return true;
    },

    onBuild: function(thing) {
        try {
            if (thing != 'power plant') return;
            if (!PowerSystem.plantBuilt()) return;
            if (PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            if (!$SM.get('game.powerSystem.plantBuiltAt', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.powerSystem.plantBuiltAt', Date.now());
            }
            PowerSystem.scheduleBox();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.onBuild error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    scheduleBox: function() {
        try {
            if (PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            var builtAt = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.plantBuiltAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = PowerSystem.BOX_DELAY - (Date.now() - builtAt);
            if (delay <= 0) {
                PowerSystem.unlockBox();
            } else {
                if (PowerSystem._boxTimer) clearTimeout(PowerSystem._boxTimer);
                PowerSystem._boxTimer = setTimeout(PowerSystem.unlockBox, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.scheduleBox error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    unlockBox: function() {
        try {
            if (PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            $SM.set('game.powerSystem.boxUnlocked', true);
            $SM.set('game.powerSystem.boxUnlockedAt', Date.now());

            if (typeof $SM.get('game.powerSystem.stored') != 'number') {
                $SM.set('game.powerSystem.stored', PowerSystem.BASE_CAPACITY);
            }


            if (!$SM.get('game.powerSystem.batch1Notified', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.powerSystem.batch1Notified', true);

                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says the heat deep underground could be used to make power'));
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says a water wheel could make power from the flowing stream'));
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says the wind could be harnessed to make power'));
            }

            PowerSystem.scheduleBatch2();
            PowerSystem.startTick();

            PowerSystem.syncDieselIncome();
            PowerSystem.updateBox();

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.updateBuildButtons) {
                Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.unlockBox error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    scheduleBatch2: function() {
        try {
            if (PowerSystem.batch2Unlocked()) return;
            var at = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.boxUnlockedAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = PowerSystem.BATCH2_DELAY - (Date.now() - at);
            if (delay <= 0) {
                PowerSystem.unlockBatch2();
            } else {
                if (PowerSystem._b2Timer) clearTimeout(PowerSystem._b2Timer);
                PowerSystem._b2Timer = setTimeout(PowerSystem.unlockBatch2, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.scheduleBatch2 error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    unlockBatch2: function() {
        try {
            if (PowerSystem.batch2Unlocked()) return;
            $SM.set('game.powerSystem.batch2Unlocked', true);

            if (!$SM.get('game.powerSystem.batch2Notified', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.powerSystem.batch2Notified', true);
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says spare power could be stored away, for the dark hours'));
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says solar panels could be made, to catch the sunlight'));
            }

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.updateBuildButtons) {
                Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.unlockBatch2 error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    startTick: function() {
        if (PowerSystem._tickTimer) return;
        PowerSystem._tickTimer = setInterval(PowerSystem.tick, PowerSystem.TICK);
    },

    tick: function() {
        try {
            if (!PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;

            var gen = 0;
            var diesel = $SM.get('stores["diesel"]', true) || 0;

            if (diesel > 0) {
                gen += PowerSystem.GEN['diesel generator']
                        * ($SM.get('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', true) || 0);
            }
            gen += PowerSystem.GEN['wind turbine'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["wind turbine"]', true) || 0);
            gen += PowerSystem.GEN['solar panel'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["solar panel"]', true) || 0);
            gen += PowerSystem.GEN['hydro generator'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["hydro generator"]', true) || 0);
            gen += PowerSystem.GEN['geothermal generator'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["geothermal generator"]', true) || 0);

            var cons = PowerSystem.BASE_LIGHT;
            for (var k in PowerSystem.USE) {
                cons += PowerSystem.USE[k] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["' + k + '"]', true) || 0);
            }

            var max = PowerSystem.BASE_CAPACITY
                    + PowerSystem.STORE_CAP['battery bank'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["battery bank"]', true) || 0);

            var stored = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.stored', true);
            if (typeof stored != 'number') stored = PowerSystem.BASE_CAPACITY;
            stored += (gen - cons);
            if (stored > max) stored = max;
            if (stored < 0) stored = 0;
            $SM.set('game.powerSystem.stored', stored, true);
            Engine.saveGame();



            if (stored <= 0) {
                if (!PowerSystem._blackoutTimer) {
                    if (!$SM.get('game.powerSystem.blackoutZeroAt', true)) {
                        $SM.set('game.powerSystem.blackoutZeroAt', Date.now());
                    }
                    PowerSystem.scheduleBlackoutCheck();
                }
            } else {
                if (PowerSystem._blackoutTimer) {
                    clearTimeout(PowerSystem._blackoutTimer);
                    PowerSystem._blackoutTimer = null;
                }
                if ($SM.get('game.powerSystem.blackoutZeroAt', true)) {
                    $SM.remove('game.powerSystem.blackoutZeroAt');
                }
            }

            PowerSystem.syncDieselIncome();
            PowerSystem.updateBox();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.tick error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    syncDieselIncome: function() {
        try {
            var income = $SM.get('income["diesel generator"]');
            if (!PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) {
                if (income) $SM.remove('income["diesel generator"]');
                return;
            }
            var diesel = $SM.get('stores["diesel"]', true) || 0;
            if (diesel > 0 && !income) {
                $SM.setIncome('diesel generator', {
                        delay: 10,
                        stores: { 'diesel': -0.1 }
                });
            } else if (diesel <= 0 && income) {
                $SM.remove('income["diesel generator"]');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.syncDieselIncome error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    scheduleBlackoutCheck: function() {
        try {
            if (PowerSystem._blackoutTimer) return;
            var zeroAt = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.blackoutZeroAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = PowerSystem.BLACKOUT_GRACE - (Date.now() - zeroAt);
            if (delay <= 0) {

                PowerSystem.onBlackoutTimeout();
            } else {
                PowerSystem._blackoutTimer = setTimeout(
                    PowerSystem.onBlackoutTimeout, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.scheduleBlackoutCheck error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    onBlackoutTimeout: function() {
        try {
            PowerSystem._blackoutTimer = null;
            var stored = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.stored', true);
            if (typeof stored != 'number') stored = PowerSystem.BASE_CAPACITY;

            if (stored <= 0) {

                PowerSystem.punish();

                $SM.set('game.powerSystem.blackoutZeroAt', Date.now());
                PowerSystem._blackoutTimer = setTimeout(
                    PowerSystem.onBlackoutTimeout, PowerSystem.BLACKOUT_GRACE);
            }

        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.onBlackoutTimeout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },







    punish: function(reason) {
        try {
            // 左侧日志打印两条消息: 不写人数, 不加句号
            // 用 printMessage 而非 notify, 以绕过 notify 自动加 "." 的行为
            if (typeof Notifications !== 'undefined' && Notifications.printMessage) {
                Notifications.printMessage('村庄没有电了');
                Notifications.printMessage('村民们逃离了村庄');
            }

            // 减 1-2 个村民, 不减少任何物资
            var kill = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
            var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true) || 0;
            if (pop > 0) {
                if (typeof Outside !== 'undefined' && Outside.killVillagers) {
                    Outside.killVillagers(kill);
                } else {
                    $SM.add('game.population', -kill, true);
                    if ($SM.get('game.population', true) < 0) {
                        $SM.set('game.population', 0, true);
                    }
                }
            }

            // 刷新村庄 UI
            if (typeof Outside !== 'undefined') {
                if (Outside.updateVillage) Outside.updateVillage();
                if (Outside.updateWorkersView) Outside.updateWorkersView();
                if (Outside.updateVillageIncome) Outside.updateVillageIncome();
            }

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                Engine.saveGameNow();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.punish error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    stealSupplies: function(total) {
        try {
            var pool = [];
            var stores = $SM.get('stores') || {};
            for (var k in stores) {
                if (k == 'compass') continue;
                var v = $SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]');
                if (typeof v == 'number' && v >= 1) pool.push(k);
            }
            var taken = 0;
            while (total > 0 && pool.length > 0) {
                var idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
                var k = pool[idx];
                var have = Math.floor($SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]'));
                var take = Math.min(have, total, 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 30));
                if (take > 0) {
                    $SM.add('stores["' + k + '"]', -take, true);
                    taken += take;
                    total -= take;
                }
                pool.splice(idx, 1);
            }
            if (taken > 0) {
                $SM.fireUpdate('stores', true);

                if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                    Engine.saveGameNow();
                } else if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGame) {
                    Engine.saveGame();
                }
            }
            return taken;
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.stealSupplies error:', e);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    },


    updateBox: function() {
        try {
            if (!PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            if ($('div#storesContainer').length == 0) return;

            var box = $('div#power');
            if (box.length == 0) {
                box = $('<div>').attr('id', 'power').css('opacity', 0);
                var weapons = $('div#weapons');
                var stores = $('div#stores');
                if (weapons.length > 0) {
                        box.insertAfter(weapons);
                } else if (stores.length > 0) {
                        box.insertAfter(stores);
                } else {
                        box.appendTo('div#storesContainer');
                }
                box.animate({opacity: 1}, 300, 'linear');
            }

            var rows = [];

            var diesel = $SM.get('stores["diesel"]', true) || 0;
            if (diesel > 0 && ($SM.get('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', true) || 0) > 0) {
                rows.push([_('diesel generator'),
                        '+' + PowerSystem.fmt(PowerSystem.GEN['diesel generator']
                                * $SM.get('game.buildings["diesel generator"]', true))]);
            }
            var genOrder = ['wind turbine', 'solar panel', 'hydro generator', 'geothermal generator'];
            for (var i = 0; i < genOrder.length; i++) {
                var k = genOrder[i];
                var n = $SM.get('game.buildings["' + k + '"]', true) || 0;
                if (n > 0) {
                        rows.push([_(k), '+' + PowerSystem.fmt(PowerSystem.GEN[k] * n)]);
                }
            }

            rows.push([_('base lighting'), '-' + PowerSystem.fmt(PowerSystem.BASE_LIGHT)]);
            var useOrder = ['hut', 'lodge', 'trading post', 'tannery', 'smokehouse', 'workshop', 'steelworks', 'armoury', 'furnace', 'power plant'];
            for (var i = 0; i < useOrder.length; i++) {
                var k = useOrder[i];
                var n = $SM.get('game.buildings["' + k + '"]', true) || 0;
                if (n > 0) {
                        rows.push([_(k), '-' + PowerSystem.fmt(PowerSystem.USE[k] * n)]);
                }
            }

            box.empty();
            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                var row = $('<div>').addClass('powerRow').appendTo(box);
                $('<div>').addClass('row_key').text(rows[i][0]).appendTo(row);
                $('<div>').addClass('row_val').text(rows[i][1]).appendTo(row);
                $('<div>').addClass('clear').appendTo(row);
            }

            var stored = $SM.get('game.powerSystem.stored', true);
            if (typeof stored != 'number') stored = PowerSystem.BASE_CAPACITY;
            var max = PowerSystem.BASE_CAPACITY
                    + PowerSystem.STORE_CAP['battery bank'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["battery bank"]', true) || 0);
            var total = $('<div>').addClass('powerRow powerTotal').appendTo(box);
            total.text(_('power: {0} / {1} kWh', PowerSystem.fmt(stored), PowerSystem.fmt(max)));
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.updateBox error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    fmt: function(v) {
        v = Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
        if (Math.abs(v - Math.round(v)) < 0.001) return String(Math.round(v));
        return v.toFixed(1);
    },


    handleStateUpdates: function(e) {
        try {
            if (!PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            if (!e) return;
            if (e.category == 'stores' || e.category == 'income'
                        || (e.stateName && e.stateName.indexOf('game.buildings') === 0)) {
                PowerSystem.syncDieselIncome();
                PowerSystem.updateBox();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('PowerSystem.handleStateUpdates error:', e);
            }
        }
    }
};

if (typeof $ !== 'undefined') {
    $(function(){
        if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && typeof Room !== 'undefined') {
            PowerSystem.init();
        }
    });
}
</script>

<script data-source="script/water_supply.js">

var WaterSystem = {

    TICK: 10 * 1000,
    BOX_DELAY: 10 * 60 * 1000,
    BATCH2_DELAY: 30 * 60 * 1000,



    DROUGHT_GRACE: 30 * 60 * 1000,

    BASE_CAPACITY: 500,


    GEN: {
        'water well': 8,
        'stream pump station': 6,
        'groundwater collector': 7,
        'water pump': 8
    },

    STORE_CAP: {
        'reservoir': 20,
        'large reservoir': 50
    },

    USE: {
        'hut': 0.5,
        'lodge': 2,
        'trading post': 1,
        'tannery': 3,
        'smokehouse': 6,
        'workshop': 2,
        'steelworks': 11,
        'armoury': 15,
        'power plant': 15,
        'water station': 5
    },

    BASE_DRINK: 2,

    CRAFTABLES: [
        'water well', 'stream pump station', 'groundwater collector',
        'reservoir', 'large reservoir'
    ],

    BATCH2: ['reservoir', 'large reservoir'],


    hasSupplyFacility: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('game.buildings["water station"]', true) > 0) return true;
            for (var i = 0; i < WaterSystem.CRAFTABLES.length; i++) {
                if ($SM.get('game.buildings["' + WaterSystem.CRAFTABLES[i] + '"]', true) > 0) return true;
            }
        } catch (e) {  }
        return false;
    },

    _boxTimer: null,
    _b2Timer: null,
    _tickTimer: null,
    _droughtTimer: null,

    init: function() {
        try {

            if (WaterSystem.plantBuilt() && !WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) {
                if (!$SM.get('game.waterSystem.plantBuiltAt', true)) {
                    $SM.set('game.waterSystem.plantBuiltAt', Date.now());
                }
                WaterSystem.scheduleBox();
            }

            if (WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) {
                if (!WaterSystem.batch2Unlocked()) {
                    WaterSystem.scheduleBatch2();
                }
                WaterSystem.startTick();
                WaterSystem.updateBox();

                var stored = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.stored', true);
                if (typeof stored == 'number' && stored <= 0 && !WaterSystem._droughtTimer) {
                    WaterSystem.scheduleDroughtCheck();
                }
            }
            WaterSystem.syncPumpDiesel();
            $.Dispatch('stateUpdate').subscribe(WaterSystem.handleStateUpdates);
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.init error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    plantBuilt: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.buildings["water station"]', true) > 0;
    },
    boxUnlocked: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.waterSystem.boxUnlocked', true) > 0;
    },
    batch2Unlocked: function() {
        return $SM.get('game.waterSystem.batch2Unlocked', true) > 0;
    },

    craftGate: function(thing) {
        if (!WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return false;
        if (WaterSystem.BATCH2.indexOf(thing) >= 0 && !WaterSystem.batch2Unlocked()) return false;
        return true;
    },

    onBuild: function(thing) {
        try {
            if (thing != 'water station') return;
            if (!WaterSystem.plantBuilt()) return;
            if (WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            if (!$SM.get('game.waterSystem.plantBuiltAt', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.waterSystem.plantBuiltAt', Date.now());
            }
            WaterSystem.scheduleBox();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.onBuild error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    scheduleBox: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            var builtAt = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.plantBuiltAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = WaterSystem.BOX_DELAY - (Date.now() - builtAt);
            if (delay <= 0) {
                WaterSystem.unlockBox();
            } else {
                if (WaterSystem._boxTimer) clearTimeout(WaterSystem._boxTimer);
                WaterSystem._boxTimer = setTimeout(WaterSystem.unlockBox, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.scheduleBox error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    unlockBox: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            $SM.set('game.waterSystem.boxUnlocked', true);
            $SM.set('game.waterSystem.boxUnlockedAt', Date.now());

            if (typeof $SM.get('game.waterSystem.stored') != 'number') {
                $SM.set('game.waterSystem.stored', WaterSystem.BASE_CAPACITY);
            }



            if (!$SM.get('game.waterSystem.batch1Notified', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.waterSystem.batch1Notified', true);
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says the deeper groundwater could be collected'));
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says the water from the stream could be drawn up for use'));
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says a well could be dug to reach the clean groundwater'));
            }

            WaterSystem.scheduleBatch2();
            WaterSystem.startTick();

            WaterSystem.syncPumpDiesel();
            WaterSystem.updateBox();

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.updateBuildButtons) {
                Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.unlockBox error:', e);
            }
        }
    },


    scheduleBatch2: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterSystem.batch2Unlocked()) return;
            var at = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.boxUnlockedAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = WaterSystem.BATCH2_DELAY - (Date.now() - at);
            if (delay <= 0) {
                WaterSystem.unlockBatch2();
            } else {
                if (WaterSystem._b2Timer) clearTimeout(WaterSystem._b2Timer);
                WaterSystem._b2Timer = setTimeout(WaterSystem.unlockBatch2, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.scheduleBatch2 error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    unlockBatch2: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterSystem.batch2Unlocked()) return;
            $SM.set('game.waterSystem.batch2Unlocked', true);

            if (!$SM.get('game.waterSystem.batch2Notified', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.waterSystem.batch2Notified', true);
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says a large reservoir could be built to store even more water'));
                Notifications.notify(Room, _('the builder says a reservoir could be built to store the extra water'));
            }

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.updateBuildButtons) {
                Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.unlockBatch2 error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    startTick: function() {
        if (WaterSystem._tickTimer) return;
        WaterSystem._tickTimer = setInterval(WaterSystem.tick, WaterSystem.TICK);
    },

    tick: function() {
        try {
            if (!WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;

            var gen = 0;
            var diesel = $SM.get('stores["diesel"]', true) || 0;

            if (diesel > 0) {
                gen += WaterSystem.GEN['water pump']
                        * ($SM.get('game.buildings["water pump"]', true) || 0);
            }
            gen += WaterSystem.GEN['water well'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["water well"]', true) || 0);
            gen += WaterSystem.GEN['stream pump station'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["stream pump station"]', true) || 0);
            gen += WaterSystem.GEN['groundwater collector'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["groundwater collector"]', true) || 0);

            var cons = WaterSystem.BASE_DRINK;
            for (var k in WaterSystem.USE) {
                cons += WaterSystem.USE[k] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["' + k + '"]', true) || 0);
            }

            var max = WaterSystem.BASE_CAPACITY
                    + WaterSystem.STORE_CAP['reservoir'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["reservoir"]', true) || 0)
                    + WaterSystem.STORE_CAP['large reservoir'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["large reservoir"]', true) || 0);

            var stored = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.stored', true);
            if (typeof stored != 'number') stored = WaterSystem.BASE_CAPACITY;
            stored += (gen - cons);
            if (stored > max) stored = max;
            if (stored < 0) stored = 0;
            $SM.set('game.waterSystem.stored', stored, true);
            Engine.saveGame();



            if (stored <= 0) {
                if (!WaterSystem._droughtTimer) {
                    if (!$SM.get('game.waterSystem.droughtZeroAt', true)) {
                        $SM.set('game.waterSystem.droughtZeroAt', Date.now());
                    }
                    WaterSystem.scheduleDroughtCheck();
                }
            } else {
                if (WaterSystem._droughtTimer) {
                    clearTimeout(WaterSystem._droughtTimer);
                    WaterSystem._droughtTimer = null;
                }
                if ($SM.get('game.waterSystem.droughtZeroAt', true)) {
                    $SM.remove('game.waterSystem.droughtZeroAt');
                }
            }

            WaterSystem.syncPumpDiesel();
            WaterSystem.updateBox();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.tick error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    syncPumpDiesel: function() {
        try {
            var income = $SM.get('income["water pump"]');
            if (!WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) {
                if (income) $SM.remove('income["water pump"]');
                return;
            }
            var diesel = $SM.get('stores["diesel"]', true) || 0;
            if (diesel > 0 && !income) {
                $SM.setIncome('water pump', {
                        delay: 10,
                        stores: { 'diesel': -0.1 },

                        timeLeft: 5
                });
            } else if (diesel <= 0 && income) {
                $SM.remove('income["water pump"]');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.syncPumpDiesel error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    scheduleDroughtCheck: function() {
        try {
            if (WaterSystem._droughtTimer) return;
            var zeroAt = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.droughtZeroAt', true) || Date.now();
            var delay = WaterSystem.DROUGHT_GRACE - (Date.now() - zeroAt);
            if (delay <= 0) {

                WaterSystem.onDroughtTimeout();
            } else {
                WaterSystem._droughtTimer = setTimeout(
                    WaterSystem.onDroughtTimeout, delay);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.scheduleDroughtCheck error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    onDroughtTimeout: function() {
        try {
            WaterSystem._droughtTimer = null;
            var stored = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.stored', true);
            if (typeof stored != 'number') stored = WaterSystem.BASE_CAPACITY;

            if (stored <= 0) {

                WaterSystem.punish();

                $SM.set('game.waterSystem.droughtZeroAt', Date.now());
                WaterSystem._droughtTimer = setTimeout(
                    WaterSystem.onDroughtTimeout, WaterSystem.DROUGHT_GRACE);
            }

        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.onDroughtTimeout error:', e);
            }
        }
    },






    punish: function() {
        try {
            // 左侧日志打印两条消息: 不写人数, 不加句号
            if (typeof Notifications !== 'undefined' && Notifications.printMessage) {
                Notifications.printMessage('村庄没有水了');
                Notifications.printMessage('村民们逃离了村庄');
            }

            // 减 1-2 个村民, 不减少任何物资
            var kill = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
            var pop = $SM.get('game.population', true) || 0;
            if (pop > 0) {
                if (typeof Outside !== 'undefined' && Outside.killVillagers) {
                    Outside.killVillagers(kill);
                } else {
                    $SM.add('game.population', -kill, true);
                    if ($SM.get('game.population', true) < 0) {
                        $SM.set('game.population', 0, true);
                    }
                }
            }

            // 刷新村庄 UI
            if (typeof Outside !== 'undefined') {
                if (Outside.updateVillage) Outside.updateVillage();
                if (Outside.updateWorkersView) Outside.updateWorkersView();
                if (Outside.updateVillageIncome) Outside.updateVillageIncome();
            }

            if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                Engine.saveGameNow();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.punish error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    stealSupplies: function(total) {
        try {
            var pool = [];
            var stores = $SM.get('stores') || {};
            for (var k in stores) {
                if (k == 'compass') continue;
                if (k == 'animal organs' || k == 'animal brains') continue;
                var v = $SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]');
                if (typeof v == 'number' && v >= 1) pool.push(k);
            }
            var taken = 0;
            while (total > 0 && pool.length > 0) {
                var idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
                var k = pool[idx];
                var have = Math.floor($SM.get('stores["' + k + '"]'));
                var take = Math.min(have, total, 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 30));
                if (take > 0) {
                    $SM.add('stores["' + k + '"]', -take, true);
                    taken += take;
                    total -= take;
                }
                pool.splice(idx, 1);
            }
            if (taken > 0) {
                $SM.fireUpdate('stores', true);

                if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGameNow) {
                    Engine.saveGameNow();
                } else if (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && Engine.saveGame) {
                    Engine.saveGame();
                }
            }
            return taken;
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.stealSupplies error:', e);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    },


    updateBox: function() {
        try {
            if (!WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            if ($('div#storesContainer').length == 0) return;

            var box = $('div#water');
            if (box.length == 0) {
                box = $('<div>').attr('id', 'water').css('opacity', 0);
                var power = $('div#power');
                var weapons = $('div#weapons');
                var stores = $('div#stores');
                if (power.length > 0) {
                        box.insertAfter(power);
                } else if (weapons.length > 0) {
                        box.insertAfter(weapons);
                } else if (stores.length > 0) {
                        box.insertAfter(stores);
                } else {
                        box.appendTo('div#storesContainer');
                }
                box.animate({opacity: 1}, 300, 'linear');
            }

            var rows = [];

            var diesel = $SM.get('stores["diesel"]', true) || 0;
            if (diesel > 0 && ($SM.get('game.buildings["water pump"]', true) || 0) > 0) {
                rows.push([_('water pump'),
                        '+' + WaterSystem.fmt(WaterSystem.GEN['water pump']
                                * $SM.get('game.buildings["water pump"]', true))]);
            }
            var genOrder = ['water well', 'stream pump station', 'groundwater collector'];
            for (var i = 0; i < genOrder.length; i++) {
                var k = genOrder[i];
                var n = $SM.get('game.buildings["' + k + '"]', true) || 0;
                if (n > 0) {
                        rows.push([_(k), '+' + WaterSystem.fmt(WaterSystem.GEN[k] * n)]);
                }
            }

            rows.push([_('base drinking'), '-' + WaterSystem.fmt(WaterSystem.BASE_DRINK)]);
            var useOrder = ['hut', 'lodge', 'trading post', 'tannery', 'smokehouse', 'workshop', 'steelworks', 'armoury', 'power plant', 'water station'];
            for (var i = 0; i < useOrder.length; i++) {
                var k = useOrder[i];
                var n = $SM.get('game.buildings["' + k + '"]', true) || 0;
                if (n > 0) {

                        var label = (k == 'water station') ? _('water purifier') : _(k);
                        rows.push([label, '-' + WaterSystem.fmt(WaterSystem.USE[k] * n)]);
                }
            }

            box.empty();
            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                var row = $('<div>').addClass('powerRow').appendTo(box);
                $('<div>').addClass('row_key').text(rows[i][0]).appendTo(row);
                $('<div>').addClass('row_val').text(rows[i][1]).appendTo(row);
                $('<div>').addClass('clear').appendTo(row);
            }

            var stored = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.stored', true);
            if (typeof stored != 'number') stored = WaterSystem.BASE_CAPACITY;
            var max = WaterSystem.BASE_CAPACITY
                    + WaterSystem.STORE_CAP['reservoir'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["reservoir"]', true) || 0)
                    + WaterSystem.STORE_CAP['large reservoir'] * ($SM.get('game.buildings["large reservoir"]', true) || 0);
            var total = $('<div>').addClass('powerRow powerTotal').appendTo(box);
            total.text(_('water: {0} / {1} L', WaterSystem.fmt(stored), WaterSystem.fmt(max)));
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.updateBox error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    fmt: function(v) {
        v = Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
        if (Math.abs(v - Math.round(v)) < 0.001) return String(Math.round(v));
        return v.toFixed(1);
    },


    handleStateUpdates: function(e) {
        try {
            if (!WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return;
            if (!e) return;
            if (e.category == 'stores' || e.category == 'income'
                        || (e.stateName && e.stateName.indexOf('game.buildings') === 0)) {
                WaterSystem.syncPumpDiesel();
                WaterSystem.updateBox();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('WaterSystem.handleStateUpdates error:', e);
            }
        }
    }
};

if (typeof $ !== 'undefined') {
    $(function(){
        if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && typeof Room !== 'undefined') {
            WaterSystem.init();
        }
    });
}

<script data-source="script/new_weapons.js">

var NewWeapons = {

    CHECK_INTERVAL: 3 * 60 * 1000,
    SHOW_CHANCE: 0.4,


    GATED: ['crossbow', 'bolt'],

    AMMO_GATE: { 'bolt': 'crossbow' },

    PHASE1: ['crossbow'],

    MSGS: {
        'crossbow': _('建造者的房间角落里多了一张弓臂和一段弦')
    },

    _timer: null,

    init: function() {
        try {
            if (NewWeapons._timer) return;

            setTimeout(NewWeapons.check, 10 * 1000);
            NewWeapons._timer = setInterval(NewWeapons.check, NewWeapons.CHECK_INTERVAL);
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('NewWeapons.init error:', e);
            }
        }
    },



    anchorUnlocked: function() {
        try {
            if ($SM.get('stores["dagger"]', true) > 0) return true;
            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.buttons && Room.buttons['dagger']) return true;
        } catch (e) {}
        return false;
    },

    crescentUnlocked: function() {
        return NewWeapons.anchorUnlocked();
    },

    isUnlocked: function(w) {
        return $SM.get('game.newWeapons["' + w + '"]', true) > 0;
    },

    craftGate: function(thing) {
        var parent = NewWeapons.AMMO_GATE[thing];
        if (parent) return NewWeapons.isUnlocked(parent);
        return NewWeapons.isUnlocked(thing);
    },

    check: function() {
        try {
            if (!NewWeapons.anchorUnlocked()) return;

            if (!$SM.get('game.newWeapons.startedAt', true)) {
                $SM.set('game.newWeapons.startedAt', Date.now());
            }

            for (var i = 0; i < NewWeapons.PHASE1.length; i++) {
                var w1 = NewWeapons.PHASE1[i];
                if (!NewWeapons.isUnlocked(w1)) {
                    if (Math.random() < NewWeapons.SHOW_CHANCE) {
                        NewWeapons.unlock(w1);
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }


        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('NewWeapons.check error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    unlock: function(w) {
        try {
            if (NewWeapons.isUnlocked(w)) return;
            $SM.set('game.newWeapons["' + w + '"]', true);

            if (NewWeapons.MSGS[w] && typeof Notifications !== 'undefined') {
                Notifications.notify(Room, NewWeapons.MSGS[w]);
            }

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Room.updateBuildButtons) {
                Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('NewWeapons.unlock(' + w + ') error:', e);
            }
        }
    }
};

if (typeof $ !== 'undefined') {
    $(function(){
        if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && typeof Room !== 'undefined') {
            NewWeapons.init();
        }
    });
}

<script data-source="script/events/wandering_merchant.js">

var WanderingMerchantEvent = {
    title: _('流浪商人'),
    isAvailable: function() {
        try {

            if (typeof PowerSystem === 'undefined' || !PowerSystem.boxUnlocked || !PowerSystem.boxUnlocked()) return false;
            if (typeof WaterSystem === 'undefined' || !WaterSystem.boxUnlocked || !WaterSystem.boxUnlocked()) return false;

            if (typeof Engine === 'undefined' || !Engine.activeModule) return false;

            return true;
        } catch (e) {

    },

                                $('<div>').addClass('row_key').text(_('供水')).appendTo(tt2);

            buttons: {

                            var cur = $SM.get('game.waterSystem.stored', true) || 0;
