<script data-source="script/events/chem_factory.js">
/*
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  化工厂扩展系统 (ChemFactory Extension)
 *  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *  触发条件: 玩家进入"废弃工厂"剧情并完成最终搜刮 (game.factoryCleared=true,
 *            并记录 game.factoryClearedAt 为完成时刻)
 *  触发流程: 安全回到小屋 (Room) 后, 计时 5 分钟 (CHEM_FACTORY_DELAY)
 *            左侧日志输出:
 *              "建造者说可以化工厂可以生产消毒剂和炸药, 卖给化学家"
 *            同时设置 game.chemFactoryAnnounced = true
 *            并把 Room.buttons['chemical plant'] = true 以解锁化工厂建筑按钮
 *
 *  解锁链路:
 *    Events.Setpieces.factory → final_loot.onLoad 设 factoryClearedAt
 *    → ChemFactoryUnlocker.poll() 每 10 秒检查时间差
 *    → 满 5 分钟 → Notifications.notify + 解锁 Room.Craftables['chemical plant']
 *    → Room.craftUnlocked('chemical plant') 返回 true 才出现建造按钮
 *    → 建造后 → Outside.checkWorker 解锁 化工工人/配液工/装药工 三个岗位
 *    → Outside._INCOME 周期产出 化工原料 / 消毒液 / 炸药
 *    → 化学家事件随机触发 (30 分钟冷却), 用上述产物兑换 鳞片/利齿/药品
 *    → 消毒液可在探险中当药品使用 (恢复 5 HP, 冷却 3 秒)
 *    → 炸药可在战斗中当武器使用 (-15 HP 敌人, 20% 概率反射 40% 自伤)
 *  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 */
var ChemFactoryUnlocker = {

    CHEM_FACTORY_DELAY: 5 * 60 * 1000,

    POLL_INTERVAL: 10 * 1000,

    _timer: null,

    init: function() {
        try {
            if (ChemFactoryUnlocker._timer) return;
            ChemFactoryUnlocker._timer = setInterval(ChemFactoryUnlocker.poll, ChemFactoryUnlocker.POLL_INTERVAL);
            ChemFactoryUnlocker.poll();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('ChemFactoryUnlocker.init error:', e);
            }
        }
    },

    poll: function() {
        try {
            if (typeof $SM === 'undefined' || !$SM.get) return;

            if (!$SM.get('game.factoryCleared', true)) return;

            if ($SM.get('game.chemFactoryAnnounced', true)) return;

            var clearedAt = $SM.get('game.factoryClearedAt', true);
            if (!clearedAt) {
                clearedAt = Date.now();
                $SM.set('game.factoryClearedAt', clearedAt);
            }

            if (Date.now() - clearedAt < ChemFactoryUnlocker.CHEM_FACTORY_DELAY) return;

            if (typeof Notifications !== 'undefined') {
                Notifications.notify(null, _('the builder says the chemical plant can produce disinfectant and explosives, which the chemist will buy'));
            }

            $SM.set('game.chemFactoryAnnounced', true);

            if (typeof Room !== 'undefined') {
                Room.buttons['chemical plant'] = true;
                if (Room.updateBuildButtons) Room.updateBuildButtons();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) {
                console.error('ChemFactoryUnlocker.poll error:', e);
            }
        }
    }
};

if (typeof $ !== 'undefined') {
    $(function(){
        if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined') {
            ChemFactoryUnlocker.init();
        }
    });
}
</script>

<script data-source="script/events/chemist_event.js">
/*
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  化学家随机事件 (Chemist Event)
 *  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *  注册进 Events.EventPool, 与"流浪商人"同一套机制.
 *  isAvailable 条件:
 *    - 当前在小屋(Room) 或 村庄(Outside)
 *    - game.chemFactoryAnnounced === true (化工厂剧情已解锁)
 *    - 距上次触发 >= 30 分钟 (CHEMIST_COOLDOWN)
 *    - 至少持有一件可兑换产物 (化工原料/消毒液/炸药) 之任一
 *  按钮(全部加 affordable 类, 显示绿色边框, 与游牧帐篷风格一致):
 *    'cmScales'    购买 鳞片  tooltip: 化工原料 1 → 鳞片 5
 *    'cmTeeth'     购买 利齿  tooltip: 消毒液 1 → 利齿 10
 *    'cmMedicine'  购买 药品  tooltip: 炸药 6   → 药品 1
 *    'cmLeave'     再会
 *  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 */
var ChemistEvent = {
    title: _('化学家'),
    CHEMIST_COOLDOWN: 30 * 60 * 1000,

    isAvailable: function() {
        try {
            if (typeof $SM === 'undefined' || !$SM.get) return false;
            if (!$SM.get('game.chemFactoryAnnounced', true)) return false;

            if (typeof Engine === 'undefined' || !Engine.activeModule) return false;
            if (Engine.activeModule != Room && Engine.activeModule != Outside) return false;

            var lastTriggered = $SM.get('game.chemistEvent.lastTriggered', true) || 0;
            if (Date.now() - lastTriggered < ChemistEvent.CHEMIST_COOLDOWN) return false;

            var hasChemMat   = ($SM.get('stores["chemical material"]', true) || 0) >= 1;
            var hasDisinf    = ($SM.get('stores["disinfectant"]', true)     || 0) >= 1;
            var hasExplosive = ($SM.get('stores["explosive"]', true)        || 0) >= 6;
            if (!hasChemMat && !hasDisinf && !hasExplosive) return false;

            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('ChemistEvent.isAvailable error:', e);
            return false;
        }
    },

    scenes: {
        'start': {
            text: [
                _('a chemist in a white coat arrives pushing a cart piled with glass bottles')
            ],
            notification: _('一个穿着白大褂的化学家推着车来了，车上堆满玻璃瓶'),
            onLoad: function() {
                $SM.set('game.chemistEvent.lastTriggered', Date.now());

                setTimeout(function() {
                    try {
                        var panel = (typeof Events !== 'undefined' && Events.eventPanel) ? Events.eventPanel() : null;
                        if (!panel) return;

                        var btnScales = $('#cmScales', panel);
                        if (btnScales.length) {
                            btnScales.addClass('affordable');
                            if (btnScales.find('div.tooltip').length === 0) {
                                var tt = $('<div>').addClass('tooltip bottom right');
                                $('<div>').addClass('row_key').text(_('化工原料')).appendTo(tt);
                                $('<div>').addClass('row_val').text('1').appendTo(tt);
                                tt.appendTo(btnScales);
                            }
                        }

                        var btnTeeth = $('#cmTeeth', panel);
                        if (btnTeeth.length) {
                            btnTeeth.addClass('affordable');
                            if (btnTeeth.find('div.tooltip').length === 0) {
                                var tt2 = $('<div>').addClass('tooltip bottom right');
                                $('<div>').addClass('row_key').text(_('消毒液')).appendTo(tt2);
                                $('<div>').addClass('row_val').text('1').appendTo(tt2);
                                tt2.appendTo(btnTeeth);
                            }
                        }

                        var btnMed = $('#cmMedicine', panel);
                        if (btnMed.length) {
                            btnMed.addClass('affordable');
                            if (btnMed.find('div.tooltip').length === 0) {
                                var tt3 = $('<div>').addClass('tooltip bottom right');
                                $('<div>').addClass('row_key').text(_('炸药')).appendTo(tt3);
                                $('<div>').addClass('row_val').text('6').appendTo(tt3);
                                tt3.appendTo(btnMed);
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('ChemistEvent.onLoad tooltip error:', e);
                    }
                }, 50);
            },
            buttons: {

                'cmScales': {
                    text: _('购买 鳞片'),
                    available: function() {
                        try {
                            return ($SM.get('stores["chemical material"]', true) || 0) >= 1;
                        } catch (e) { return false; }
                    },
                    onChoose: function() {
                        try {
                            var cur = $SM.get('stores["chemical material"]', true) || 0;
                            if (cur < 1) {
                                Notifications.notify(null, _('you don\'t have enough for the chemist\'s price'));
                                return;
                            }
                            $SM.addM('stores', { 'chemical material': -1, 'scales': 5 });
                            if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.fireUpdate) $SM.fireUpdate('stores', true);
                        } catch (e) {
                            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('cmScales.onChoose error:', e);
                        }
                    }
                },

                'cmTeeth': {
                    text: _('购买 利齿'),
                    available: function() {
                        try {
                            return ($SM.get('stores["disinfectant"]', true) || 0) >= 1;
                        } catch (e) { return false; }
                    },
                    onChoose: function() {
                        try {
                            var cur = $SM.get('stores["disinfectant"]', true) || 0;
                            if (cur < 1) {
                                Notifications.notify(null, _('you don\'t have enough for the chemist\'s price'));
                                return;
                            }
                            $SM.addM('stores', { 'disinfectant': -1, 'teeth': 10 });
                            if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.fireUpdate) $SM.fireUpdate('stores', true);
                        } catch (e) {
                            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('cmTeeth.onChoose error:', e);
                        }
                    }
                },

                'cmMedicine': {
                    text: _('购买 药品'),
                    available: function() {
                        try {
                            return ($SM.get('stores["explosive"]', true) || 0) >= 6;
                        } catch (e) { return false; }
                    },
                    onChoose: function() {
                        try {
                            var cur = $SM.get('stores["explosive"]', true) || 0;
                            if (cur < 6) {
                                Notifications.notify(null, _('you don\'t have enough for the chemist\'s price'));
                                return;
                            }
                            $SM.addM('stores', { 'explosive': -6, 'medicine': 1 });
                            if (typeof $SM !== 'undefined' && $SM.fireUpdate) $SM.fireUpdate('stores', true);
                        } catch (e) {
                            if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.error) console.error('cmMedicine.onChoose error:', e);
                        }
                    }
                },

                'cmLeave': {
                    text: _('再会'),
                    nextScene: 'end'
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

$(function() {
    try {
        if (typeof Events !== 'undefined' && Events.registerEvent) {

<script data-source="script/layout.js">

(function() {
        function adjustHeight() {
                var content = document.getElementById('content');
                var stores = document.getElementById('storesContainer');
                if (!content || !stores) return;

                var panel = stores.parentElement;
                while (panel && panel !== document.body) {
                        if (panel.parentElement && panel.parentElement.id === 'outerSlider') break;
                        panel = panel.parentElement;
                }
                if (!panel || panel === document.body) return;

                var cRect = content.getBoundingClientRect();
                var pRect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();

                var maxBottom = stores.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;

                var roomActive = (typeof Engine !== 'undefined' && typeof Room !== 'undefined' && Engine.activeModule === Room);
                if (roomActive) {
                        var btnCols = ['buildBtns', 'craftBtns', 'buyBtns'];
                        for (var i = 0; i < btnCols.length; i++) {
                                var col = document.getElementById(btnCols[i]);
                                if (col) {
                                        var b = col.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
                                        if (b > maxBottom) maxBottom = b;
                                }
                        }



                        maxBottom += 120;
                }

                var storesBottomInContent = maxBottom - cRect.top;
                var storesBottomInPanel = maxBottom - pRect.top;

                var BUFFER = 120;
                var extraContent = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(storesBottomInContent) - 700 + BUFFER);
                var extraPanel = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(storesBottomInPanel) - 700 + BUFFER);

                var ps = document.getElementById('scroll-spacer-panel');
                if (extraPanel > 10) {
                        if (!ps) {
                                ps = document.createElement('div');
                                ps.id = 'scroll-spacer-panel';
                                ps.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:1px;clear:both;visibility:hidden;margin-top:700px;';
                                panel.appendChild(ps);
                        }
                        ps.style.height = extraPanel + 'px';
                } else if (ps) {
                        ps.remove();
                }

                var cs = document.getElementById('scroll-spacer-content');
                if (extraContent > 10) {
                        if (!cs) {
                                cs = document.createElement('div');
                                cs.id = 'scroll-spacer-content';
                                cs.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:1px;clear:both;visibility:hidden;margin-top:700px;';
                                content.appendChild(cs);
                        }
                        cs.style.height = extraContent + 'px';
                } else if (cs) {
                        cs.remove();
                }
        }





        var _adjustTimer = null;
        function scheduleAdjust() {
                if (_adjustTimer != null) return;
                _adjustTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                        _adjustTimer = null;
                        adjustHeight();
                }, 50);
        }

        setTimeout(adjustHeight, 500);
        setInterval(adjustHeight, 2000);
        window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleAdjust);

        if (typeof $ !== 'undefined' && $.Dispatch) {
                try {
                        $.Dispatch('stateUpdate').subscribe(function() {
                                scheduleAdjust();
                        });
                } catch(_e) {}
        }

        window.scheduleAdjustHeight = scheduleAdjust;
})();

</script>

</body>
</html>
